Convert exported custom managed data to Variant-compatible representation or a GodotObject-derived data type.

Prefer typed managed APIs; inspect Variant type before conversion because mismatches may coerce, default or throw; enums need explicit integer or generic conversion.
Use ptr/ptrw for packed-array bulk access and respect copy-on-write across Variant calls; do not assume modifying an extension argument mutates caller data.
Inspector defaults are source-analyzed rather than getter-executed; explicit revert overrides resolve complex defaults; initialize exported collections and validate assignment types.
Use managed collections for internal loops and Godot collections at engine boundaries; conversions copy and marshal all elements; supported packed arrays map to managed arrays.

Official C++ binding workflow is separate from raw C ABI and covers build systems, API core differences and optional in-editor documentation.

Custom visual shader nodes register through class_name without plugin.cfg; define port counts/types/defaults and shader mode before emitted code; third-party noise code requires license review.
Choose GetNodeOrNull for optional dependencies and GetNode for invariants; TOOLS is a build define, not a runtime editor check; platform defines do not establish export support.

Use top selected nodes for transforms to avoid moving both parent and child twice; add_node does not focus the inspector and deprecated transformable selection should be replaced.

This experimental importer supports binary and ASCII FBX from version 3000 with meshes, skins, blends, materials and rigging; test representative source files and reimports rather than promising universal FBX parity.

Resolve editor cache, config and data paths through EditorPaths rather than OS assumptions; guard this editor-only singleton in scripts shared with runtime and preserve signed macOS bundles when using self-contained mode.
Set script_owner when using this specialized Node script property picker so its attach-script and contextual operations target the correct node.
Apple embedded export base covers iOS and visionOS, excluding macOS; route actual export configuration to the concrete platform subclass and retain device/toolchain validation boundaries.

Return arrays containing msgid and optional context, plural, comment and source line; register through EditorPlugin and use ResourceLoader for script source. The illustrated C# CSV parser leaves ret uninitialized and requires repair plus compilation before reuse.

This experimental workspace API marks direct parse, diagnostic, signal and endpoint access deprecated due to effects on connected clients; prefer a regular TCP LSP client and reserve script API generation and URI conversions for optional tooling.

Register and remove debugger plugins with editor lifecycle; capture a prefix and return true only for recognized messages. Set up each debugger session independently and check active state before interacting because setup can precede start.

Use emit_changed instead of manually emitting property_changed; refresh widgets in _update_property and honor _set_read_only. Register keyboard-focusable controls to restore focus after inspector refresh, add bottom-editor control as a child first, and guard edited-object access outside callbacks where association is guaranteed.

Filter supported objects in _can_handle and register through EditorPlugin; property editors must subclass EditorProperty. Return true from _parse_property only when replacing the built-in editor, and use the multiple-property registration API for coordinated editing.

Save imported output to save_path plus the declared extension and propagate ResourceSaver errors; record generated resources and platform variants, increment format version for incompatible output, and distinguish importer priority from dependency order. Enable threaded import only after thread-safety verification. The C# example dereferences FileAccess.Open before a null guard and must be corrected.

Use editing_integer and control_state for integer versus slider behavior; hide_slider is deprecated despite the introductory step-based explanation. Deferred dragging commits at input completion and read_only disables interaction, useful for expensive inspector previews.
Initialize the modifier editor with both action map and modifier and handle its removal signal in the owning tool; this is an OpenXR action-map editor control, not gameplay input binding management.

Setting source_code does not reload implementation; check reload error and can_instantiate rather than treating absent source as invalid, since binary-tokenized scripts remain usable. Instantiate concrete subclasses and compare Object.get_script instead of deprecated instance_has.
The graph operation maps to texture_sdf(sdf_pos), so supply SDF-space coordinates rather than assuming screen UV input.
Synchronized playback runs multiple streams together; prefer its resource for aligned layers and keep playlist sequencing as a separate choice.
A horizontal separator visually divides vertically arranged controls; style through its line StyleBox and use containers for layout behavior.
Use this sdf_to_screen_uv graph conversion when an SDF result must sample a screen-space effect; do not reuse SDF positions as UV coordinates.
The spring-bone plane is infinite XZ with +Y normal and only participates in SpringBoneSimulator3D; rotate it to the intended barrier orientation and do not infer general physics-body collision.
Use a concrete haptic resource such as OpenXRHapticVibration; this page documents only its base role and cannot establish device feedback behavior.
Playlist playback sequences multiple streams; author the AudioStreamPlaylist resource and use its playback component rather than interpreting it as simultaneous mixing.
This modifier base applies to individual interaction-profile actions, with AnalogThresholdModifier as a concrete subtype; retain optional XR mapping and device verification boundary.
This node casts against the screen signed-distance field and returns distance travelled; it is a visual-shader SDF operation rather than physics raycasting.
No class description or operations are documented; retain an audio API lookup entry without inventing a packet playback recipe.
StandardMaterial3D uses separate AO, roughness and metallic textures; select ORMMaterial3D for a packed ORM map, while detailed properties come from BaseMaterial3D.
This graph parameter emits uniform sampler3D; provide a volume texture rather than a 2D texture or TextureArray assumption.
Vorbis playback uses OggPacketSequencePlayback and inherits resampling support; route normal file playback through AudioStreamOggVorbis instead of undocumented packet internals.
Choose Image import for CPU scripting access and Texture import for rendering; an imported Image has no direct rendering capability.
The ring emitter selects particle positions using inner/outer radius and height; validate those geometric settings rather than using it as a general mesh emitter.
Use depth reconstruction for world-space projection effects such as caustics; its output is a pixel world position, requiring appropriate coordinate mapping for sampling.
Use this uniform texture lookup for triplanar mapping when mesh UVs are unsuitable; inherited texture parameters define the sampled resource.
FBXDocument is experimental and inherits document operations; export Blender FBX with FBX Units Scale to preserve scale through reimport workflows, then validate generated scenes.
Create a varying with a mode compatible with the shader function before adding a setter; a fragment setter requires fragment-to-light mode.
High-shelf changes gain for frequencies above cutoff, suitable for clarity adjustments; compare audible effect and bus levels rather than confusing it with high-pass removal.
Create Tweeners through Tween methods rather than constructors; finished can mean invalidation from a freed object, so behavior assertions must check the target state rather than the signal alone.
Twenty-one bands span 22 to 22000 Hz for finer tone shaping, sharing -60 to +24 dB range; choose band resolution by the measured mixing need and validate output levels.
faceforward returns N only when dot(I,Nref) is negative and otherwise -N; set the incident and reference vectors deliberately rather than relying on the broad introductory same-direction description.
Reroutes adapt their port type from the incoming connection; query get_port_type when tooling validates graph links instead of assuming a fixed scalar/vector type.

The case-sensitive --text-driver Dummy disables text rendering and font management, allowing optional text-cost comparison or nonvisual server memory reduction; do not count this as a usable GUI optimization without restoring text.
Ten bands span 31 to 16000 Hz with documented -60 to +24 dB gain; choose this resolution for broad tone shaping and measure headroom after boosts.
Choose rotation-based CCD for constrained chains and large rotations, preserving prior twist; test targets near the chain root because joint flips and oscillation remain documented failure cases.

Dedicated servers can retain this image-free placeholder to shrink packs; missing derived classes can also produce it, so client-side unexpected placeholders require version/import diagnosis and cannot render reliably.
Marker3D is a transform hint with an editor cross; gizmo_extents changes editor visualization rather than runtime geometry or collision extent.
Band-pass preserves frequencies near cutoff and attenuates outside them; use it for weak-speaker effects and distinguish it from band-limit and notch rejection.

This resource constrains ChainIK3D through a cone hole angle; the default is represented numerically as radians while examples describe degrees, so verify setter units and boundary poses before offering a recipe.
Use the unsigned integer constant node for uint graph ports; its inspector value uses Godot int representation, so preserve the unsigned shader type distinction.
Choose a circle for suitable round collision outlines and set its radius; the page documents cheaper checks than rectangles and capsules, but actual project performance still needs measurement.
Render an assigned SubViewport on this experimental XR quad and set quad_size for dimensions; headset/runtime composition support and visual output remain environment-specific validation.
Boolean constants have one bool output and no inputs; use them for fixed graph conditions and choose parameters instead when runtime variation is needed.
Resizable visual-shader size controls editor graph layout, not shader data dimensions; preserve this metadata when authoring curve/group/frame nodes.
Set a timeout for signals that may never arrive; AwaitTweener finished also occurs on timeout or freed target, so assert the awaited behavior separately from sequence completion.
XR camera node tracking can lag render-thread tracking; with use_xr active most Camera3D settings are overridden except near and far, so diagnose apparent camera differences through the XR interface.
Create callbacks only through Tween.tween_callback and set optional delay in seconds; freed callback targets finish the tweener without establishing that the callback ran.
The fixed Color node emits separate RGB vec3 and alpha float ports; connect both deliberately when opacity participates in the output.
JNI singleton exists only in Android exports and bridges Java/Kotlin plugin methods/signals; guard platform availability and use has_java_method for optional plugin capabilities.
Particle axis-angle multiplication defaults to degrees_mode true; convert or toggle units when connecting angle data from radian-producing calculations.

Generate optimized translations in editor for messages without context/plurals; generation is inert in exports and message list/count deliberately omit originals, so validate translation lookup rather than count-based completeness.
This node supplies a fixed Vector3 input, default zero; choose a vec3 parameter when a material needs runtime-adjustable vector state.
Reuse uniform sets keyed by shader, set index and uniforms on RenderingDevice renderers; cache entries are cleaned when dependent objects are freed, so manage dependency RID lifetimes.
Pass this experimental anchor capability header to spatial-context creation before querying enabled components; the query is invalid before use, and device extension availability must be tested.
Treat factor as a multiplicative gesture delta centered near one; enable Android pan-and-scale gestures before diagnosing missing pinch input on that platform.
Use concrete RD layered texture wrappers only for low-level RenderingDevice RID integration; ordinary layered textures are the preferred default, and the base cannot be used directly.

Sphere attractors influence GPU particles only and support nonuniform scaling into ellipses, unlike common physics collision constraints; diagnose CPU particle nonresponse as an incompatible node choice.
Connect concrete emitter output to Position in the particle shader start stage; mode_2d projects output to 2D rather than changing the emitter family.
Choose concrete CSG primitives for level prototyping and avoid nested CSG motion in gameplay because recomputation has CPU cost; flip_faces reverses triangle winding to expose backfaces.

Use this bone transform target within SkeletonModifier3D processing cycles when another modifier depends on bone motion; select a valid parent Skeleton3D bone instead of substituting a differently timed BoneAttachment3D.

UDS is local-machine filesystem IPC limited to Unix-like systems; check listen errors and stale socket files under an owned path, and provide a Windows-compatible transport instead of claiming local support.
Use the is-inf or is-NaN function to identify invalid scalar shader results; FUNC_MAX is an enum size sentinel rather than a comparison operation.
A bool graph parameter becomes uniform bool; default_value takes effect only when default_value_enabled is true, so validate the generated material default explicitly.

A separation ray pushes its endpoint to a collision point for stair handling; slide_on_slope false returns its own direction as normal, while true permits real surface normals and arbitrary separation.
Create/map anchor nodes by tracked IDs on availability and allow pose/size updates while plane detection learns; an undetected predefined anchor remains at origin, which is not detection success.
This parameter emits uniform vec3 and requires default_value_enabled to activate its Vector3 default; distinguish shader declarations from per-material overrides.
Set size as width/height/depth and material for a CSG prototype box; avoid gameplay nested CSG movement and replace static production geometry when CPU recomputation is measured.

Use concrete volume/array sampler descendants; source texture creates an internal uniform while source port consumes a connected sampler, so choose source according to graph ownership of texture binding.

Use concrete compressed layered texture resources and check load errors; the description names CompressedTexture3D although the declared hierarchy differs, so use exact concrete binding inheritance rather than this broad prose.
For animated 2D platforms use physics processing and sync_to_physics to estimate velocity affecting riders; do not combine synchronization with move_and_collide.
UV input defaults to shader UV; panning adds offset times scale, while scaling pivots around an explicit point, so use the matching function and wire a custom UV only when needed.
Read polygon vertices with the associated snapshot RID and entity index and use the matching transform to position them; experimental query data needs device-supported snapshot validation.
Register navigation implementations during server initialization and set defaults by priority; the manager cannot switch implementations during runtime gameplay.

Animate platforms and doors in physics mode with synchronization and estimated velocity; synchronization must not be combined with move_and_collide, and force-driven bodies need a different body type.
Choose scalar or vec2/3/4 operand type for a*b+c graph operation; type selection affects every input/output, and fused representation alone is not measured project optimization.
Put tracked cameras/controllers/anchors directly under the active origin, move the origin for virtual locomotion, and maintain one current origin; world_scale defaults to one game unit per meter.

Set lower-case built-in input_name valid for the shader type/stage and use get_input_real_name for generated shader identifiers; changing input emits input_type_changed and may require graph link validation.
Integer function defaults to sign rather than abs; choose abs, negation, sign or bitwise NOT deliberately and keep integer ports distinct from float operations.
Select float, signed/unsigned integer or vector clamp type matching the graph value and provide explicit min/max; enum MAX is only a sentinel.

This volume texture inherits Texture3D and uses internal imported .ctex3d files; VRAM compression reduces GPU memory/loading at artifact cost, so validate volume sampling quality and target format support.
Select transform/vector multiplication order and 3x3 versus full matrix deliberately; 3x3 skips the last row/column and is appropriate when translation must be excluded.
Vertical scrollbars increase top-to-bottom, opposite VSlider; horizontal grabber padding uses theme constants while vertical padding uses scroll StyleBox content margins.

Directional 2D light ignores position and uses global +Y direction; light masks do not filter its illumination. Shadow distance culling ignores Camera2D zoom, so diagnose zoom-related fading through max_distance.

Use a linearly sampled Texture3D in the attractor box for spatially varying GPU particle forces; low-frequency fields can use low resolution matching box proportions, and CPU particles remain unaffected.
Assign a sub-emitter before using emit_subparticle and choose override flags for position, rotation/scale, velocity, color and custom data; missing sub-emitter cannot be fixed by shader flag changes.

Supply an equirectangular Texture2D panorama rather than cubemap and prefer .hdr/.exr for reflection energy; adjust energy multiplier and filtering, while display HDR output remains a separate pipeline decision.

This experimental holder composes multiple modification stacks on one Skeleton2D, but held modifications execute only when their execution mode matches the holder; inspect mode before diagnosing inactive IK.
PacketPeerStream adds its own framing protocol over StreamPeer, so do not concurrently read/write the wrapped stream directly; Android exports need INTERNET permission before network troubleshooting.
RenderData is internal frame data lasting only one viewport render; consume provided data in its render callback and do not instantiate or retain it as persistent game state.
Retrieve the bus effect instance and query a frequency range in linear energy, with x/y as left/right channels; choose maximum or average aggregation and convert units explicitly for dB displays.
Custom profiler ticks supply frame/process/physics times in seconds while active, and explicit frame data enters via EngineDebugger; keep units and profiler enabled state in benchmark evidence.

Concave 2D segments are hollow and intended for static level geometry; dynamic/fast bodies can pass into their interior. Use convex solid decomposition for closed dynamic shapes, supply endpoint pairs, and reassign copied segment arrays after edits.
Smoothstep interpolates across edge0/edge1 with Hermite smoothing; verify current port binding for vec4-scalar mode because its prose names a/b/weight unlike the documented smoothstep operands.
Choose radial segments and rings for the silhouette budget; full height differs from radius, and a regular hemisphere requires equal height/radius rather than the full-sphere diameter ratio.
Match RDUniform binding index and uniform_type to shader layout and add the resource RIDs required by that binding; clear/get IDs are binding management rather than resource destruction.
JavaClass comes from JavaClassWrapper and only works on Android; introspect Java method signatures and parent class there, and keep it distinct from Web JavaScriptObject.
Box UVs use a 3x2 face atlas; scale UV by 3x2 for repeating one texture per face. For large-floor UV jitter, increase relevant subdivision axes and compare the artifact against added geometry cost.

Particle collisions require GPU particles and a rigid/hide-on-contact material mode; cull_mask uses particle rendering layers, hiding disables a collider, and nonuniform scale is unsupported. Raise fixed_fps or use zero for moved-collider stutter only after measuring.

Margins are theme constants applied around direct children as a group, not ordinary node properties; use add_theme_constant_override and combine with an inner layout container when child spacing is needed.

External platform buffers require Android builds plus the relevant OpenGL/Vulkan extension; texture ID and buffer ID serve different platform integration calls, and local Windows rendering is not validation.

Viewport texture paths are relative to the local scene root and data can be wrong before ready; HDR2D readback is linear and may need sRGB conversion for display. Decal/lights require slow ImageTexture conversion, so avoid per-frame readback conversions.
Share a FoldableGroup for accordion behavior and set allow_folding_all if an entirely closed state is permitted; default scene-local resources keep separate UI instances independent.
Enable toggle_mode on all radio-group members and choose allow_unpress according to whether no selection is valid; resource_local_to_scene defaults true to isolate instantiated screen groups.

For incremental HMAC call start, repeated update, then finish and check each error plus nonempty output; another start is invalid before finish. Validate known bytes rather than merely printing the result.

Custom import plugins generally order below scene import 100 so scene dependencies exist first; _get_build_dependencies reports engine compile-profile module needs, distinct from imported-resource ordering.
Use radius/radial segments/rings for prototype geometry and smooth_faces for shading only; smooth normals do not replace needed silhouette tessellation and nested motion incurs CSG CPU work.
Float operators include actual max/min while OP_ENUM_SIZE is the sentinel; step treats a as edge and b as x, so verify threshold wiring instead of assuming interchangeable operands.

Uniform names are case-sensitive shader identifiers and edits affect all instances sharing a material; prefer supported instance uniforms for independent values. Resource.changed is not a general uniform-change notification.

Delay loading scene parts with placeholders and instantiate on the main thread or deferred call; placeholders have no transform and created nodes become siblings above them, so test hierarchy and child transforms after replacement.

Vector arithmetic generally works component-wise while cross/reflect have vector-specific semantics; reflect uses a incident and b normal. Step prose differs from scalar step explanation, requiring generated-code/binding verification before a threshold recipe.

Stream partial writes and drain buffered output to limit allocations; compression needs finish plus a final drain. Intro implies generic finish at stream end but the method restricts it to compression, so follow binding/source verification for decompression lifecycle.

Store document-extension state on GLTFAnimation additional data because extensions are stateless; original_name is preserved, while undocumented loop semantics require exact import/export behavior checks.

Visibility enables/disables the target process_mode via a cached relative path; the heuristic ignores wall occlusion unless occlusion culling is active and requires the enabler visible, so it is not reliable gameplay line-of-sight.

Use CanvasGroup self_modulate for combined overlapping opacity; a custom material overrides its backbuffer shader and clip_children conflicts with grouping. Minimize clear/fit margins and enable mipmaps only for effects requiring them, then verify edges.
Integer operators support arithmetic and bitwise operations; OP_MIN prose incorrectly says max(a,b), so verify generated code before using the minimum operation and do not propagate that typo.
Enable cone to apply radius to one end; sides alter geometric detail while smooth_faces alters normals. Keep moving nested CSG out of production runtime paths unless measured and justified.

Use a unit curve and choose red-only storage when shaders sample red, or RGB for compatible consumers; width trades high-frequency representation against generation/memory, and CurveXYZTexture packs three separate curves.

Parent physical bones under this skeleton modifier and start all or named subsets of simulation; inspect is_simulating_physics and validate affected bones, collision exceptions and stop behavior rather than only animation playback.

Godot integer Variants use 64-bit values while C# inferred int is 32-bit; explicit Variant casts and shared Array/Dictionary semantics matter for interop. The C# example uses reserved identifier ref and the fixed 20-byte claim is ABI-specific, so neither is suitable as an unverified implementation premise.

Choose independent position/rotation/scale channels and global versus local coordinates; remote_path is relative and target references are cached, so force_update_cache after replacing/removing the target when propagation stops.

Actions use resource names for registration and top-level paths to constrain device usage; match analog/boolean/vector/pose types and reassign copied path arrays after edits. XR conversion and device thresholds need runtime confirmation.

Analyzer resource configures nonaltering FFT analysis, while runtime queries use the bus instance; choose FFT size for latency/stability and buffer length for retention/memory, keeping both fixed during tests.
Handle pressed/released and canceled state explicitly; scroll factor is platform-dependent and may be zero, and Wear OS rotary events map to configured wheel axes.

Plane meshes have no thickness and default face +Y; billboard materials need face +Z. Increase subdivisions for large textured-floor jitter only as far as visually needed and separate mesh center_offset from node transform.

CSV locales occupy headers after the key column, underscores exclude metadata, and context/plural special columns select translation semantics. Auto compression falls back from optimized translation when context/plurals are present; test escaping flags and plural rows.
Get/put advance a byte cursor; setting data_array resets it while resizing does not. Returned bytes are copied, so reassign modifications and validate cursor/size before binary decoding.

VehicleBody3D needs per-wheel nodes, contact and traction/steering flags; steer in code radians and use +Z model front with a low origin for center of gravity. It has documented realism limitations, so advanced vehicles may need custom integration rather than tuning alone.

Choose texture versus sampler-port source explicitly because the other source is ignored; color mode adds source_color for sRGB-to-linear conversion, while data/normal modes require different handling.

Use an XRNode3D ancestor tied to the same body tracker for world placement, motion_scale for model fit, and rotation-only mode to preserve bone lengths; body-part flags and device body tracking availability need explicit verification.

Attraction uses rendering-layer masks plus process material interaction enablement; strength sign reverses direction, directionality blends center attraction toward local -Z, and hiding or zero strength disables the effect.

Access the existing dock through EditorInterface rather than instantiating it; listen to file move/removal/selection events and retrieve selection paths through the interface. It exposes navigation and tooltip registration, not file mutation methods.

Attachment properties index a supplied texture list; mark unused entries -1, bind input attachments in RDUniform, preserve needed data across passes and supply nonmultisampled resolves for MSAA. Mobile benefit is workload-dependent, with little desktop advantage documented.

Use short-circuit boolean conditions to guard dependent/expensive checks; numeric conversion treats nonzero values including INF/NaN as true, so it is not numeric validity validation and C# conversions differ.

RIDs are opaque session-local handles, unsuitable as persistent save or cross-peer resource identifiers; is_valid only tests nonzero, so keep server ownership/lifetime checks separate from empty-handle detection.

Route the sidechain to a voice bus for ducking and verify gain reduction and recovery on actual signals. Attack is expressed in microseconds while release is in milliseconds, so copying equal numerical values changes the envelope dramatically.

CollisionShape2D contributes geometry to its CollisionObject2D parent; update disabled through set_deferred. One-way collision is ignored by Area2D, uses a configurable direction, and its pixel margin must be retested at representative approach speeds.

Experimental TLAS instances reference a BLAS and can occupy an instance index even when the BLAS is invalid. Custom IDs, visibility masks and hit SBT allocations belong to the RenderingDevice ray-tracing path, requiring device support and version-matched binding checks rather than physics raycast substitution.

Accept connected UDP peers into DTLS then poll each peer until its handshake completes; cookie exchange can yield rejected attempts and does not prove application connection failure. The embedded client sample uses obsolete boolean certificate-validation arguments, requiring TLSOptions binding verification and production certificate validation before reuse.

Choose lookup source and texture semantic separately: source_color performs sRGB-to-linear conversion, while hint_normal selects normal-map treatment. Depth requires a spatial depth-prepass path and normal/roughness buffers require Forward+, so a graph must be tested under its selected renderer.

Instantiate a concrete filter subclass and select cutoff frequency and octave slope for the audible goal. Gain applies only to shelf filters and resonance changes meaning for shelf, band/notch and pass filters, so compare spectral and listening evidence rather than treating these controls interchangeably.

Camera conversion changes unit conventions: glTF vertical FOV is radians whereas Camera3D uses degrees, and orthographic magnitude is a radius whereas Godot size is a diameter. Round-trip node and dictionary conversion must assert projection and clipping values to catch these mismatches.

Read inputs using action names supplied by the active XRInterface and OpenXR action map rather than assuming generic button IDs. Tracker-driven transforms support child controller visuals, while profile changes and runtime tracker availability require device lifecycle testing.

Configure body_test_motion from a global transform and displacement, keeping RID exclusions distinct from object instance IDs. Separation rays normally aid depenetration but can stop motion when enabled; recovery_as_collision determines whether overlap recovery counts, so floor-snap diagnostics must test both overlap and swept movement.

Radiance-map updates must match sky change frequency: quality for static content, incremental for slow changes and realtime for per-frame changes. Automatic mode changes with shader inputs and realtime forces 256-square cubemaps, so increasing radiance_size alone may be ignored and must be measured with the actual shader.

OBJ defaults to a Mesh rather than a PackedScene, making it useful for direct mesh consumers. Diagnose blocky normals or UVs through compression settings, require tangents for normal/height maps, and enable UV2 generation before tuning lightmap texel size; reimport and inspect saved output after changes.

The joint starts its twist around local X and derives the moving twist axis from both body frames. Swing and twist limits below 0.05 lock the corresponding motion; diagnose limb constraints by checking local frames before changing bias, softness or relaxation and retest under the selected physics backend.

GraphElement represents selectable graph content without connection ports; choose GraphNode for connectable nodes. Resize handles emit requests and require explicit size application, while position_offset is relative to graph scrolling; persist model coordinates and implement undo for drag and resize completion.

Prefer original MP3 over lossy transcoding when no lossless source exists; high concurrency may justify WAV to reduce Vorbis decode CPU. Looping suppresses normal finished emission, beat_count can define a music endpoint earlier than file duration, and runtime loading belongs on AudioStreamOggVorbis rather than deprecated importer methods.

Use one binding_path per binding resource, including separate left and right entries, instead of deprecated multi-path helpers. Paths are runtime suggestions and may be remapped; validate effective device actions rather than equating serialized paths with physical controller inputs.

Noise generation is threaded and data can be unavailable until changed fires; asynchronous recipes must await completion before reading slices. Seamless generation trades time and contrast, with small dimensions needing a wider blend skirt, so verify texture edge continuity and memory at the chosen volume resolution.

Dpad emulation adds directional paths when its extension is enabled; mixing these with normal bindings for the same control in one action set can reject suggested bindings. Threshold and release threshold implement hysteresis, while sticky wedges and haptics need controller-runtime validation.

Plane visuals and collision shapes must both refresh on mesh_changed and apply get_mesh_offset relative to tracked pose. Meshes can fall back to bounds; manually setting or clearing discovery data is only appropriate when the application owns discovery, and experimental device support remains an acceptance condition.

The reference exposes indexed and named bind records with Transform3D poses but provides no descriptions for their semantics. Keep this as an API index and require Skeleton3D documentation, engine implementation and deformation round-trip checks before authoring procedural bind-pose recipes.

Retain each returned stream ID only while that playback remains active; natural completion, individual stop or stopping the polyphonic playback invalidates it. Polyphony exhaustion returns INVALID_ID instead of automatically stealing a voice, so implement an explicit failure or prioritization policy and test routing per stream.

Setup uses polygon vertices and paired edge indices; odd connection counts are rejected. Most path and penalty methods lack prose, so retain an on-demand API index and verify topology, reachable paths and penalty behavior through source and tests before using it as an alternative to NavigationServer.

Occlusion culling consumes CPU and benefits closed scenes rather than broadly open ones; moving occluders triggers background recomputation, so avoid per-frame motion. Bake opaque static blockers while excluding dynamic and small fixtures, inspect the culling buffer for over-occlusion, and account for default Web template exclusion.

Custom uniform defaults require default_value_enabled; range, step and enum controls only activate under the matching hint. enum_names returns a copy requiring reassignment after edits; verify generated shader and material readback rather than assuming inspector hints enforce every runtime input.

Once linked, AnimationTree owns playback and transitions while AnimationPlayer is the animation library editor. Select process timing through inherited AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process rather than deprecated tree methods, verify anim_player and expression base node paths, and inspect discrete/deterministic mixing behavior.

Use screen_relative for captured-mouse aiming because relative scales with content stretch and captured velocity reads zero. Accumulation limits default event frequency; zero-motion events can occur and stop detection needs a timer, so test sensitivity across resolutions and drawing continuity at high cursor speeds.

BLAS geometry supports triangle lists, indexed or non-indexed, but not strips. Vertex/index offsets and vertex stride are byte units while counts are element counts; validate buffer layout, formats and device support against the experimental ray-tracing implementation before building geometry.

Ray endpoints are global coordinates and exclusions are body RIDs with copy-modify-reassign semantics. Areas are excluded by default, inside hits return zero normals, and concave/heightmap shapes have different inside/backface rules; include those cases in missed-hit diagnosis.

Separate minimum-size behavior from texture stretching: keep-size can prevent container shrinkage while ignore-size permits it. Aspect-covered clips content, tiling cannot use AtlasTexture with nonzero margins, and fit-width/height modes are experimental in containers; test layout at narrow and wide resolutions.

Bone indices follow depth-first hierarchy order and can change with setup; bind intended bones deliberately rather than relying on sibling position. Pose overrides are local to the target Bone2D, with strength and persistence controlling blending and lifetime; test reset and modification-stack interaction.

ZIP creation requires open, start_file, write_file, close_file and close with every returned Error checked. Only one entry can be open at a time; compression is captured at start_file, store mode suits already compressed assets, and zero timestamps select current time rather than deterministic metadata. Verify archives by readback.

The render engine supplies this configuration when a viewport changes; internal render size and target display size differ under scaling. Mipmap bias is ignored in Compatibility, and FSR sharpness only matters when FSR is selected; compositor code must use current configuration instead of assuming viewport dimensions.

Prefer a retained Shape3D resource to prevent shape lifetime loss during queries; a Servers API RID needs explicit ownership and free_rid after use. Areas remain disabled by default, exclusions require reassignment after mutation, and query motion and transform must be checked separately. The C# sample uses reserved identifier params and needs correction before compilation.

Add peer connections while STATE_NEW so transport channels can be created, and implement offers/descriptions through separate signaling because this peer only polls. Presence in the peer map does not establish connectivity: all three channels must open; distinguish mesh from server/client relay topology and test Android INTERNET permission.

Configure an intended Bone2D and target path before applying rotation offsets; enabling constraints is separate from setting angle limits. Inverted constraints permit angles outside the interval, so test both boundary sides and interplay with animation in the experimental modification stack.

Send only after STATE_OPEN and apply backpressure using queued-byte count; closing flushes queued data but accepts no new messages. Non-negotiated IDs and unspecified lifetime/retransmit limits use 65535 sentinels, text/binary mode changes interoperability, and channel poll is documented as unused.

Texture usage bits define permitted operations and discardable draw targets can omit content preservation between frames. Shared views require adding both the alternate format and the main format to the shareable list; verify dimensions, sample count, resolve destination and RID cleanup in device-backed tests.

UPnP device calls are synchronous and block, so gateway discovery/control must avoid stalling the frame loop. A valid IGD only potentially supports forwarding and external-address queries may return empty; check mapping result codes and clean up the exact port/protocol mapping during connection shutdown.

DPITexture rerasterizes SVG theme imagery according to canvas scale and oversampling, with get_scaled_rid tied to the currently drawn item. Premultiplied alpha requires matching material blend mode; test icon sharpness and borders at multiple DPI values and preserve an experimental API compatibility check.

Camera-specific attributes override WorldEnvironment defaults; GI consumers use exposure only. Auto-exposure requires Forward+, depth of field excludes Compatibility and transparent viewports, and negative transition distances select physical blur scaling, so visual fallback and cost checks must use the actual camera and renderer.

Noise is an abstract sampling interface; seamless fallback requests enlarged data and blends swapped quadrants, affecting contrast and generation cost. Image normalization disabled assumes generator output in minus-one to one, and 3D generation returns image slices for ImageTexture3D rather than a flat 2D image.

Layered textures require compression choices that preserve intended channels and HDR alpha: forced HDR VRAM compression discards alpha, while lossy quality reduces disk size without lowering runtime memory. mipmaps/limit is unimplemented, mip overhead differs for volumes versus arrays, and compact cubemap arrangements help avoid hardware dimension limits.

Query marker-family support on the actual device before discovery. Discovery callbacks normally occur before and after snapshot processing, but errors skip the successful second call; consume component_data only after processed=true and handle future failure rather than waiting indefinitely for two callbacks.

Physical attributes override Camera3D clipping, FOV and aspect policy, so changing Camera3D properties alone may not change output. Aperture and reciprocal-second shutter controls require physical light units; focal length uses millimeters while focus distance uses meters, and renderer restrictions still govern exposure and blur.

TextureButton uses state sprites instead of Theme styling and remains clickable without a normal texture, so invisibility is not equivalent to disabled. Focus is a texture overlay, click masks define curved hit regions, and minimum-size handling is separate from stretch mode; validate mouse and keyboard states after resizing.

CanvasLayer order overrides child z_index and equal layer indices produce nondeterministic inter-layer ordering. Split-screen needs one layer per viewport; screen-fixed HUD uses viewport following disabled, and hiding a layer does not propagate into nested layers, so verify viewport assignment and overlay/window ordering.

Movie capture uses non-real-time fixed delta and is inappropriate as a real-time frame-time benchmark. Custom writers must register early and handle begin/frame/end; graceful SceneTree.quit finalizes output while Ctrl+C skips end. AVI has a 4 GB limit, transparent PNG capture is unsupported, and Theora encoding is editor-only.

JavaScriptBridge is a Web-export capability that custom templates can disable. Retain callback objects with exactly one Array argument, initiate downloads from user interactions, and treat PWA update as reload of all tabs requiring saved state; buffer conversion copies data and force_fs_sync is mainly for non-FileAccess writes.

This backend extension exposes required virtuals for signaling, ICE, polling, state and channel construction but supplies no behavioral prose. Use the parent WebRTCPeerConnection contract plus a version-matched native backend implementation and interoperability tests before promising a custom WebRTC implementation.

Portable textures are code-created self-contained resources; compression choice must suit target GPU formats and 2D versus 3D usage. Set buffer retention and BasisU parameters before create_from_image; without retained source-compressed data a loaded texture cannot be resaved, so verify save-load-save behavior and account for editor global retention.

Game scenes normally consume tracker data through XRNode3D/XRAnchor3D; pose and input setters belong to XRInterface implementations. Invalidating a pose preserves its last transform, so tracking-loss policy must explicitly hide or freeze visuals; base input helpers are deprecated in favor of XRControllerTracker.

Directional light ignores position and emits along global minus-Z. Cascaded shadow count, maximum distance and split blending trade detail for cost; diagnose frustum-edge artifacts through pancake size and distinguish sky-only illumination from direct scene lighting, measuring with the same camera path.

SkeletonIK3D is deprecated; reserve guidance for existing-project diagnosis and prefer supported SkeletonModifier3D alternatives for new work after binding verification. A valid target_node overrides target, continuous start applies next frame while one-time resets next frame, and stop clears skeleton-wide global overrides, potentially affecting other override owners.

Editor tool queries return editor bindings, so project tooling must read ProjectSettings input entries. load_from_project_settings clears runtime custom actions, and non-exact event matching ignores extra modifiers or axis direction; persist rebinding separately and test pressed/released and deadzone behavior after restoration.

Sign and verify hashes using private and public keys respectively; asymmetric encryption accepts payloads limited by key size and is not bulk save encryption. Cryptographic random bytes and constant-time comparison serve authentication inputs. The C# sample uses undefined Data instead of data and array reference equality, so correct it and test tampered signatures and content equality.

A navigation link supplies a path connection for special traversal, not the jump or teleport implementation itself. Endpoints are local unless using global helpers and must attach within map link radius; test shared map/layers, one-way direction, enabled state and cost-based route selection across separate regions.

This native physics-backend interface replaces internal queries and passes output buffers and pointers, making it unsuitable as an ordinary gameplay script query recipe. Method semantics are undocumented here; require pinned native definitions, output capacity and exclusion checks, and behavioral parity tests before implementing a custom backend.

Overlapping navigation regions do not guarantee connection: compatible nearby edges and map margin are required. Node properties cache state independently of direct Server RID edits; threaded baking replaces the mesh on completion and can synchronize slowly on mesh reads, so wait for completion and test an actual cross-region path.

Constraint settings select a modified apply bone and a read-only reference; list index is not a skeleton bone index. Bone references use local space while Node3D references use model space relative to the owning Skeleton3D, so verify transforms and per-setting amount before diagnosing unexpected motion.

Diagnose missing 2D light through enabled/editor_only, canvas-layer and z ranges and receiver masks separately from shadow-caster masks. DirectionalLight2D ignores the receiver cull mask; PCF smoothing only applies under a PCF filter and can streak, requiring visual checks plus measured filter cost.

Treat mesh, skin, skeleton and camera fields as GLTFState indices, not scene instance IDs; children is a copied packed array and requires reassignment or append_child_index. Resolve imported bone paths through get_scene_node_path with skeleton handling, and store per-node extension state in additional_data because document extensions are stateless.

Use a derived expression node, allocate free port IDs and validate shader names before wiring; count is not reliable as next ID after removals. Serialized port format shown as id,type,name; conflicts with colon-separated prose, requiring source or round-trip verification.

Choose a runtime ResourceFormatLoader for formats shipped as-is versus EditorImportPlugin for preprocessing. Return Resource or Error from required _load, preserve UID/type/fallback dependency records, and implement cache modes deliberately: IGNORE still reuses external dependencies whereas IGNORE_DEEP does not. Test dependency renames and UID persistence across moving files.

Snapshot packet sender/channel/mode before consuming the next packet; allocate independent channels for independent streams and account for channel zero separating transfer modes. close and forced disconnect suppress disconnected signals, so teardown must explicitly clear application state; Godot multiplayer wire protocol is not a stable interface for non-Godot servers. Poll blocking behavior needs backend source verification before per-frame assumptions.

Configure auth_callback before connecting; absent callback accepts peers immediately. Authenticating peers are absent from get_peers and accept only auth traffic; both sides must complete_auth before peer_connected, while timeout/disconnect uses peer_authentication_failed. Keep object decoding disabled for untrusted traffic and set relay policy before sessions.

Require vector-contour dynamic fonts; bitmap/color emoji glyphs cannot generate TextMesh. Font size, curve step, pixel size and offset regenerate costly geometry, so animate node scale/position instead. Depth zero changes UV packing to full front face, and resource translation must be controlled separately from node auto_translate_mode.

Prefer typed signal member connections; emitted arguments precede Callable.bind arguments. Guard reconnect/disconnect with is_connected and retain exact callable identity. C# example numbering differs from GDScript so do not repeat blanket option-3 recommendation; generated events plus explicit delegate lifetime handling are language-specific.

Ray target is local while returned collision point is global; results persist to next physics tick unless force_raycast_update is called, which also works when disabled. Area detection defaults off, parent exclusion requires a CollisionObject2D parent, and get_collider may be TileMapLayer so guard type before shape-owner lookup. Inside hits can have zero normal.

Separate texture margins that partition nine-patch borders, content margins that position content, and expand margins that only enlarge drawing. Negative content margins fall back to texture margins. Test tiny and large controls; TILE_FIT may stretch slightly for seamless repeats, region_rect selects atlas region and draw_center can leave only border.

Ship explicit fallback fonts for reproducible CJK/emoji coverage because system fallback varies and is unavailable on Web. Preload selected glyph ranges to trade startup/memory for first-use stutter; disable subpixel positioning for pixel fonts. MSDF removes rerasterization cost on size changes but outline range must be at least twice maximum outline and mipmaps consume additional memory.

Use VehicleWheel3D only with VehicleBody3D and document known realism limitations; custom vehicle integration may be needed. Place wheel origin at bottom-out and retain nonzero rest length. Steering radians, traction flags versus per-wheel force, surface contact and vehicle mass all affect motion; check is_in_contact before interpreting world-space contact fallbacks or skid info.

Select Web extension/thread variants explicitly with matching templates and hosting conditions. Threaded builds require cross-origin isolation; Godot worker pool must be smaller than Emscripten preallocated pool with capacity for dedicated physics/render threads to avoid deadlock. PWA header helper and offline page require actual served-browser verification, not merely export success.

Choose relative/additive combination explicitly: rest-relative transfer can add to current pose or target rest, absolute transfer can add or replace pose. Relative is only available for bone references; scale transfers ratios while position transfers differences. Constrained rotation beyond 180 degrees may flip, requiring endpoint and animated-range tests.

Prefer buffer views for arbitrary extension data; accessors describe typed GPU data with separate element count, component width and byte offsets. Use accessor_type over deprecated type, constrain core UNSIGNED_INT to mesh indices, and validate sparse alignment and absence of byteStride/target. min/max packed-array getters are copies; test serialize/parse round-trip.

Use zero target plus force_shapecast_update for same-tick overlap detection, including while disabled; Area2D overlap updates are delayed. Iterate actual collision_count bounded by max_results, and distinguish safe from unsafe sweep fractions because discrete sampling leaves a gap. Margin trades precision for robustness and shape sweeps cost more than rays.

Check a collision and collider type before shape-owner lookup because CSG/GridMap hits are not CollisionObject3D. Face index only identifies ConcavePolygonShape3D faces; inside-volume hits have zero normals and do not cover heightmaps/concave surfaces. Local target, global point, backface settings and cached physics tick results need distinct diagnostics.

SkeletonProfile defines target retargeting names and reference poses, not source skeleton indices; Humanoid settings are read-only while custom profiles need explicit sizes/hierarchy/required mappings. Root bone at origin and scale_base_bone for height normalization serve different purposes. Tail direction only selects calculation method; actual coordinates and calculation live externally.

Only obtain ENetPacketPeer from its connection service/get_peers; is_active means valid connection wrapper, not communication-ready STATE_CONNECTED. Graceful disconnect and disconnect_later require service event processing, immediate/reset omit local notification or remote notice. Normalize packet loss by 65536 and sample at documented update intervals; unreliable throttle can deliberately drop packets before transmission.

Poll threaded loading once per frame and call load_threaded_get only at LOADED to avoid blocking; handle failed/invalid states and request Error. exists can succeed for unsaved cache takeover, so persistence requires disk/readback evidence. list_directory preserves resource names after export but ordering is nondeterministic. Export text-conversion warning requires binding/runtime verification rather than blanket disabling optimization.

GDScript packed arrays share references unless duplicated, while built-in property getters return copies requiring reassignment. Sort before bsearch, check -1 find results, and distinguish negative [] indices from get rejecting negatives. to_byte_array encodes null-terminated UTF-8 strings and needs matching decoding contract; C# uses language-specific array semantics.

Use a shared FoldableGroup for one-open accordion behavior and ui_accept for keyboard activation. Title-bar controls are reparented and obscure clickable title area; removing them does not free them. Verify folding signal, child visibility, focus overlay and RTL/bottom title theme variants, noting bottom placement vertically flips StyleBoxes.

Experimental internal XR capability requires initialized runtime and separate anchor/persistence/scope support checks. Anchor transforms are XROrigin3D-local; async persistence does not cancel by dropping its future. Await successful unpersist before removing persistent anchors, free created persistence contexts, and test restart restoration on target device. Discovery processed callback may be skipped on error.

Treat EditorExportPreset as read-only export configuration; get_project_setting evaluates target feature overrides rather than host OS overrides. Inspect filters, customized strip/keep/remove and has_export_file for missing assets, verify patch base packs and script mode separately. Runnable toggle is deploy eligibility, not evidence of executable success; do not log encryption key or env credentials.

Isolate plugin/module catalogs with TranslationDomain and use find_translations with exact versus locale-compatible matching. Domain locale override and pseudolocalization mutations do not refresh scene text automatically; propagate translation notification after batching changes. Test expansion, fake RTL and placeholder-preserving pseudo text alongside plural/context translations.

Slider axis uses pivot X; separate linear/angular limit response, in-limit motion and orthogonal response parameters when diagnosing drift. Enum prose for linear orthogonal restitution/damping links to motion properties incorrectly, so use explicit enum/binding and backend support verification. Validate actual constrained motion and limits rather than accepting getter values as proof.

Build explicit graph edges with directional semantics; destination point weight multiplies segment cost and lower weights may choose a longer geometric route. neighbor_filter_enabled is required and true filters out neighbors. Disabled start yields empty even same-ID path; partial path may be slow with disabled target and is not arrival. Serialize exclusive access to a shared AStar path query.

Create hosts on both ends and call service regularly on sender and receiver; handle four-field events and dequeue receive packets from event peer. Service timeout is milliseconds and default zero; flush only sends queued packets. Compression must match, DTLS setup precedes connect, and pop_statistic resets counters. NAT socket_send needs external endpoint discovery and cannot solve symmetric NAT.

Register custom visual nodes with @tool and class_name, provide code and explicit port counts/default values, and assign through supplied generated variable names. Namespace global helpers to prevent collisions; per-function insertions have undefined order. Restrict mode/stage availability and mark Forward+/Mobile-only nodes high-end; validate compilation with duplicate instances and target renderers.

Chorus creates delayed modulated copies, not additional AudioStreamPlayer voices. Tune dry/wet ratios separately from per-voice dB gain and respect delay/depth milliseconds versus LFO/cutoff Hz. Test mono-to-stereo widening, clipping/headroom and perceived modulation with the bus effect enabled/bypassed; inspector voice numbering needs method index verification.

are_points_connected checks a direct segment, not general reachability despite introduction wording; use a path result for reachability. Supply an admissible heuristic for actual weighted traversal cost, including weights below one; unscaled Euclidean estimates can overestimate cheap routes. Verify optimal cost against reference routes, directional edges, disabled starts and partial endpoints; share instance only with exclusive query access.

Use split_offsets array over deprecated singular field; offsets are relative to minimum-size/expand-ratio layout and getter copy requires reassignment. Clamp with intentional priority after restoring saved offsets and resizing. Hidden dragger remains draggable unless disabled; internal drag-area controls must not be freed, and custom children can intercept pointer input.

Configure transform copy masks separately from axis enable/inversion masks and relative/additive rest semantics. Inverted scale means reciprocal rather than negative scale; one-axis quaternion inversion may rotate unflipped axes unexpectedly. One rotation axis preserves its roll whereas two discard invalid-axis roll; assert actual resulting bone poses with masked and nonidentity rests.

Use a measured custom AABB to avoid skeleton bounds recalculation while preserving visibility; ignore_occlusion_culling does not disable frustum culling, and disabling all culling requires RenderingServer instance RID configuration.

Instance transparency and visibility fades require Forward+; positive transparency uses the slower transparent pipeline but preserves shadows. Verify renderer-specific fallback, threshold hysteresis, and sorting visually.

Double lightmap texel scale quadruples texel count; migrate the deprecated scale enum, budget bake memory, and use instance uniform declarations with exact case-sensitive names for per-instance shader changes rather than shared material uniforms.
Vector3i components remain 32-bit even in double-precision builds; choose scalar int or PackedInt64Array for large grid coordinates and test overflow boundaries.
Converting Vector3 truncates toward zero, so negative-world grid addressing needs explicit floor before conversion; remainder is truncated and negative wrapping needs posmod per component.

Float multiplication/division produces Vector3 while integer operations preserve Vector3i. Relational comparison sorts lexicographically, not by distance, and max/min axis ties choose X/Z respectively.

Process parent-bone look-at modifiers before child modifiers and avoid selecting a child-origin bone or child BoneAttachment that the modifier itself moves; the sampled origin pose otherwise disagrees with rendered direction.

Relative mode changes the limitation basis from rest to current pose; angular limits use radians, overshooting Tween transitions can exceed limits, and near-origin safety margin triggers interpolation. Test target crossings, flips, and animated base poses.

Read limitation state after modification_processed. The is_interpolating prose incorrectly equates true with zero remaining seconds; verify the pinned engine binding before using it as a safe-removal condition.

Main translation domain uses the empty StringName and cannot be removed; give editor plugins private non-godot-prefixed domains and release those domains on disable instead of clearing project translations.

Locale switching applies previously loaded resources and standardizes hyphen/underscore codes; distinguish project locale, system locale and editor tool locale, and test exact versus similarity-based matching of regional variants.

Use find_translations instead of deprecated single get_translation_object; translate_plural selects by quantity and context. format_number/parse_number describe numeral-system conversion, so do not promise general currency/grouping formatting without additional API evidence.

Modify pre-import geometry by clearing and rebuilding surfaces, registering blend-shape names before surface addition; preserve per-vertex array lengths and flags instead of treating ImporterMesh as a runtime ArrayMesh.

get_mesh caches the converted resource until clear and can mutate a supplied base mesh on initial conversion. Test reimport and save/readback to detect stale cached conversion or shared mesh mutation.

merge_importer_meshes requires matching transform counts, corrects negative-scale winding, and may merge same-name/formatted surfaces using the first material. It discards blend shapes and LODs and never deduplicates weighted surfaces; use only after asserting these losses are acceptable.

LOD generation normal_merge_angle is degrees, normal_split_angle is unused compatibility baggage, and bone transforms compensate skinning scale. Validate generated counts and visual transition rather than tuning the unused argument.

Lightmap baking is editor-only and scoped to children of the LightmapGI parent; require static GI meshes with valid UV2, supported baking hardware and saved data. PrimitiveMesh/CSG are unsupported, and procedural exported levels need another GI approach.

Dynamic objects receive indirect light from probes but direct light remains real-time; scene environment mode ignores the editor preview sky/sun. Inspect WorldEnvironment and bake again when changing parameters.

Bake exposure ignores auto exposure; adjust bake bias for acne versus detached shadows separately from real-time light bias. JNLM-only denoiser parameters and texture-bounce leak tradeoffs require backend-aware diagnosis.

Double texel density quadruples texels. Supersampling increases bake memory/time but downsamples to unchanged output density; validate actual target atlas hardware limits rather than assume the documented 16384 default is universally portable. Shadowmask is experimental and requires rebake when enabled.

Match bake cell size/height to the navigation map; radius and height round up while climb rounds down, so thin corridors and ledges need quantized-boundary test cases. Radius zero may prevent correction of outline precision errors.

Tile-aligned baking combines bounded AABB, border size and edge_max_error at most 1.0 to avoid erosion at tile boundaries; assert cross-tile path connectivity after synchronization instead of relying on polygon count.

Select explicit versus recursive group geometry deliberately; collision mask only affects parsed static colliders. Region min/merge values are squared cell counts, and detail mesh sample values are cell units.

Manual create_from_mesh requires indexed triangle geometry; clear_polygons retains vertices whereas clear resets both. The agent_max_climb prose says minimum ledge height despite the maximum property name, requiring binding and actual traversal verification.

Polygon Boolean operations may return multiple contours and holes; process every result and distinguish winding using Cartesian coordinates, whose clockwise interpretation reverses on screen Y-down coordinates. Convex hull repeats the first point at the end.

Offsetting grows/shrinks geometry rather than translating it; use Transform2D for translation. Polyline negative offsets return empty, cap types affect endpoint extent, and miter joins fall back to square at extreme corners.

Line intersection takes a point plus direction on an infinite line while segment intersection takes endpoints. Check null explicitly, and distinguish a segment-circle hit fraction including zero from the -1 miss sentinel.

Triangulation returns groups of three indices and can fail with an empty result; polygon output uses counterclockwise winding. Include degenerate contours, boundaries, holes and disjoint results in procedural collision/mesh verification.

Use affine_inverse for scaled or skewed transforms and reject zero determinant; inverse and basis_xform_inv require orthonormal basis. Directions use basis_xform without translation, while positions use transform multiplication.

Local operations right-multiply and parent/global operations left-multiply; parent-child composition and scalar multiplication (which also changes origin) need explicit point roundtrip tests. Bulk packed-array transformation avoids per-element loops.

C# parameterless struct initialization produces zero axes rather than identity, so initialize Transform2D.Identity explicitly. The page get_scale C# sample incorrectly uses Vector3 calls with two arguments; repair to actual Vector2 constructors and compile before inclusion.

Identity is false in GDScript boolean context; use explicit validity/finite/determinant checks rather than truthiness. Approximate comparison is appropriate after transform arithmetic; looking_at aligns the X axis in global space.

Record get_version_info full commit, build/status, binary architecture and feature tags for reproducibility; architecture describes the executable rather than the host CPU and engine singletons differ from project Autoload nodes.

FPS caps may be constrained by VSync; increasing physics tick rate raises CPU cost and may require increasing max steps per render frame to avoid slowdown. time_scale changes simulation delta but not audio speed or tick count.

Use is_editor_hint for tool-versus-game execution, OS editor feature for editor build, and is_embedded_in_editor before unsupported window changes. Unregistering user engine singletons does not free their objects, so plugin shutdown needs explicit ownership cleanup.

Headless drawn-frame counter is always zero while process-frame counter continues. Release stack capture/local-variable tracking requires settings; retained captured object references can prevent freeing. Diagnostic tools must restore global error/stdout flags rather than silently hiding unrelated faults.

Choose alpha blend, discard, opaque prepass or hash based on translucency, shadows and sorting costs; alpha blend never casts shadows and text/outline render priority only affects transparent sorting in disabled alpha-cut mode. Test cursive overlap and outlines visually.

fixed_size compensates distance but camera FOV or orthographic size still changes apparent size; no_depth_test renders by draw order and can still be covered later. Billboard, depth and backface choices need camera-distance/angle acceptance.

Increasing font_size while decreasing pixel_size preserves world dimensions with more glyph detail but can add new-character rasterization stalls. Width, offset and spacing use pixels; language controls shaping and BiDi requires mixed-direction text verification.

GridMap uses MeshLibrary mesh/collision/navigation items and octant grouping; it is not VisualInstance3D and cannot use its visibility layers. Separate cell_size spacing from cell_scale item dimensions, and use local/global conversion explicitly when picking cells.

bake_navigation creates one region per populated cell with an item navigation mesh using item navigation layers. Set map through GridMap rather than directly in NavigationServer to keep node state consistent; test adjacent-cell connection and layer filtering.

make_baked_meshes generates geometry and optional UV2 but does not bake lighting; get_bake_meshes can generate on demand. Its mesh/transform pair ordering is reversed from get_meshes, so inspect types before consuming arrays.

Orientation is restricted to 24 indexed orthogonal rotations; negative item clears a cell and -1 is the empty sentinel. Octant bounds queries may include empty octants, while used variants do not; resource_changed is a deprecated no-op.

Normalize quaternions before rotation/interpolation and normalized axes before axis-angle construction; a direct Basis constructor requires orthonormal input and otherwise returns identity. Preserve scale separately.
C# default Quaternion is all-zero rather than identity. Use Quaternion.Identity and check finite/normalization; GDScript identity truthiness is false and does not mean an invalid rotation.

Composition multiplies parent by child, while addition and scalar multiplication do not compose valid rotations by themselves. q and -q encode identical orientation but component equality differs; verify resulting transformed vectors rather than exact sign in acceptance.

Euler creation uses intrinsic YXZ with radians whereas get_euler permits other decomposition orders. angle_to has unusually large floating error, so choose an explicit tolerance instead of is_zero_approx for angular convergence; test antipodal and near-180-degree interpolation cases.
Projection stores four columns; prefer Transform3D for ordinary affine transforms. C# default Projection is ZERO whereas GDScript default is identity, so explicitly initialize before camera math.

Perspective creation uses vertical FOV in degrees and ordinary X:Y aspect, but get_fov returns horizontal degrees and get_fovy expects reciprocal aspect. Include known-aspect and near/far plane numerical checks.

Depth correction remaps -1..1 to 0..1 with optional Y flip; do not assume this alone matches renderer reverse-Z conventions. Verify actual camera projection and shader clip/depth conventions in the pinned engine.

Matrix multiplication returns Vector4 clip coordinates, and the near-adjusted helper requires perspective input. HMD helpers use eye 1/2; runtime XR integration must use runtime projection rather than infer device calibration from generic math helpers.
Projection lacks is_equal_approx in this snapshot; compare columns with tolerances after inverse/product arithmetic and reject singular matrices instead of using identity truthiness.

Reducing amount_ratio avoids restart and only changes future emission but does not save allocated particle processing; reduce amount for a genuine capacity/performance reduction. Emission rate depends on amount times ratio divided by lifetime.

One-shot finished may precede immediate emitting=true readiness; restart avoids that delay but clears live particles. Continuous emitters never send finished, so cleanup and reuse recipes must distinguish modes.

Visibility AABB controls active region and collision/attraction coverage, with custom_aabb overriding it; sample the complete effect lifetime rather than capture one frame when fixing disappearing trails.

Trails need both trail-enabled node and particle-trail mesh material configuration; subemitters stop standalone target emission, and emit_particle is unsupported in Compatibility and process material can overwrite supplied color/custom data.

Fixed seed plus preserved restart seed gives repeatable seek/replay conditions; paused speed scale and requested emitting/residual process time support timeline seeking. Large preprocess can overload one frame, while draw-order index is required for motion vectors/TAA ghosting diagnosis.

Prefer HTTPRequest for ordinary asynchronous game requests; low-level HTTPClient requires ongoing poll and explicit DNS/connect/TLS/request/body states, deadlines, bounded chunks and HTTP response-code validation independent of transport Error. Reuse a connected client.

Body length may be -1 for streaming/chunked and is always -1 on Web; completion cannot depend solely on advertised length. Header dictionary preserves case and joins values, so normalize lookup deliberately and preserve raw headers when repeated field semantics matter.

Android requires INTERNET permission and Web obeys browser CORS; configure intended origins rather than copying wildcard CORS guidance into authenticated services. TLS supports certificate verification but this snapshot lacks revocation/pinning support.

The request C# sample creates fresh unconnected clients and lacks a leading slash; replace with the already-connected client and actual endpoint. Byte payload length differs from string character count for UTF-8, so use correct encoded byte lengths or engine-generated headers and validate Unicode requests.

GET body is ignored by this API and ordinary URL parameters use the path after host; proxy, OPTIONS and CONNECT have separate URL forms. Do not retry state-changing requests blindly after ambiguous network completion; test redirect, timeout, chunked and HTTP-error cases.

Manual processing plus advance supports controlled tests; physics-driven bodies require aligned physics callbacks and consumption after animation results are applied. Deferred method tracks avoid deleting/modifying mixer state during animation evaluation.

Deterministic blending accumulates without normalization and uses RESET or zero for missing tracks; normalized blending changes additive-node meaning. Test mixed track sets, total weights zero/greater than one and discrete bool/int/string behavior instead of assuming a networking determinism guarantee.

reset_on_save is editor behavior that applies RESET for serialization while retaining preview values; reopen saved scene to assert actual initial properties. Cached node targets may need clear_caches after hierarchy changes.

Root-motion delta and accumulator are different quantities; accumulators can jump at loop boundaries and require initialized prior values. Root_motion_local changes translation/rotation ordering and root track must resolve a bone with appropriate 3D track type.

The page motion examples use _process for move_and_slide and uninitialized previous/current rotation variables; scale accumulator example applies differences as scale, collapsing unchanged axes. Replace with verified physics-step recipes and test turns, loops, state changes and saved animation resources before reuse.
Looping animations do not emit documented started/finished signals; inspect playback state for loop lifecycle. Audio max polyphony is per assigned AudioStreamPlayer, not a global voice cap.

TileMapLayer replaces deprecated multi-layer TileMap with separate layer nodes. Serialized coordinates wrap outside signed 16-bit bounds; chunk large worlds and test save/reload at boundary coordinates instead of relying on Vector2i runtime range.

Updates and scene-tile instantiation are deferred to frame end inside the tree; parent ready cannot assume scene tiles already exist. Batch edits and await update/synchronization, using expensive update_internals only when immediate state is required.

Physics quadrants merge collision shapes and get_coords_for_body_rid returns quadrant coordinates; exact-cell RID identification requires quadrant size 1 with a performance tradeoff. Rendering quadrant tuning does not apply with Y sorting.

Runtime tile-data subresources remain shared with TileSet and must be duplicated for local mutation; only opt in affected cells, batch notify_runtime_tile_data_update, and handle cleanup when hidden/disabled/detached.

Terrain connect/path can update neighboring tiles and require all terrain combinations. Assert surrounding cells as well as target cells, and use layout-aware neighbor/map_pattern functions for hexagonal or half-offset maps.

TileData getter is null for scene sources; scene tiles require atlas (0,0) and alternative scene ID. map_to_local returns cell center while ignoring texture origin. Raw tile_map_data getter returns a copy; reassignment and saved readback are required for persistence.

Register native OpenXR wrapper at core initialization before OpenXR initialization; return extension names with stable bool pointers for optional support and null pointer for mandatory extensions. xr_version zero is an editor feature query, not a live instance.

Schedule writes to render-owned data through RenderingServer.call_on_render_thread regardless of thread model. Composition/projection/view-location chains returned on render thread need valid backing storage through the next pre-render callback; temporary stack pointers are invalid.

Composition layer, projection layer and frame-info callbacks require corresponding provider registration; composition order zero belongs to the main projection layer, and post-draw only guarantees command queuing rather than GPU completion.

Session/instance initialization and teardown brackets rendering lifetime and allow safe main-thread resource setup/release; handle stopping/loss/recreation rather than equate visible with focused input. Reserve view storage before view-configuration chaining.

Register controller metadata even on unsupported hosts and when no live OpenXR API exists, so editor action maps remain authorable. Native pointer ABI, separate renderer threads, session loss and actual headset runtime require native/toolchain and device validation.

Export file references use UID when available while export_file_path stores a raw movable path; choose deliberately and test asset relocation. export_storage serializes/duplicates hidden state unlike ordinary variables, and export_custom passes unvalidated hint/usage to editor.

Tool buttons use nonserialized method Callables and editor undo/redo actions; avoid member lambda cycles in RefCounted resources. Dynamic EditorInterface singleton lookup still needs editor-hint/null guards, since the provided lookup snippet alone can fail in exports.
