onready evaluates immediately before ready rather than init; abstract contracts require compatible implementation or abstract subclasses. Export custom Inspector types need class_name registration and Node exports belong to Node-derived scripts.

RPC annotation grants transport-call rights rather than validating gameplay input; defaults authority/call_remote/reliable, channel must be fourth argument. Validate sender and data, plus consistent configuration on peers.

Assertions skip condition side effects in release and failure returns from current method; acceptance runners must use explicit failure reporting/exit behavior for release checks. NaN checks require is_nan and integer division zero is an error.

Use Color.from_rgba8, type_convert and ClassDB.class_exists instead of deprecated helpers. inst_to_dict is nonrecursive, shares reference values and supports only external GDScript instances, so use explicit versioned save schemas.

preload requires constant path and runs at parse time; load uses CACHE_MODE_REUSE and relative paths prefix res:// rather than script folder. The text-resource binary-conversion warning and static_unload never-free bug note require pinned binding/runtime reproduction before capability claims.

TabBar draws a selector but does not manage child page visibility; close requests require app removal/cleanup code. Keep stable page identity in metadata and synchronize content when tabs reorder or move between grouped bars.

tab_changed means a selection transition while clicked/selected can fire for the current tab; avoid repeated expensive page initialization. Handle current_tab -1, all hidden/disabled tabs, close-selected fallback and keyboard selection.

Clipping adds overflow navigation while unclipped tabs expand minimum size. Test long localized titles, scroll-to-selected, RTL shaping, icon width caps and drag-hover delay rather than assuming desktop-width behavior.
Focus StyleBox overlays selected base and must preserve readable base styling; test keyboard/controller focus plus hover/disabled/selected colors. MSDF range must cover twice outline size.

The generated tab_{index}/icon prose incorrectly describes hiding; verify actual icon bindings rather than copying that text. Local tab rectangles/hit testing and -1 miss sentinel should drive pointer handling.

Packed array variables share references but builtin property getters return copies; duplicate before independent mutation and reassign changed getter arrays. Preallocate with resize and check returned Error plus actual size before byte encoding.

Numeric decode failures return zero, indistinguishable from valid zero without offset/width checks; encoders require allocated byte ranges. Variant decoding needs has_encoded_var/type/schema validation with allow_objects false for external input.

Compression mode and container headers must match; dynamic decompress only accepts brotli/gzip/deflate and should use a positive output cap to avoid unbounded expansion. Test truncated, wrong-mode and oversized payloads.

Packed numeric/vector conversions interpret groups of raw bytes, with vector widths depending on engine precision; input length alignment and explicit external wire formats are mandatory. Byte-swap mutates complete words and leaves trailing incomplete bytes untouched.

UTF-8 is preferred for user input and invalid data can return empty strings; wchar differs Windows UTF-16 versus other platforms UTF-32, and multibyte encodings are system-specific. Persist a specified encoding instead of host defaults.

get rejects negative indices and returns zero on failure while [] supports negative indexing and errors out of bounds; find miss -1 must be checked before indexing. Slice end is exclusive and bsearch requires sorted bytes.

2D Y points down and angle from positive X uses radians; distinguish angle_to between directions from angle_to_point between positions. Signed cross-product orientation must use the same screen/Cartesian convention as geometry routines.

Godot bounce takes a surface normal and corresponds to other engines reflect; Godot reflect takes a line direction. slide requires normalized normals, projection on zero produces NaN, and near-zero normalization requires explicit stability handling.

move_toward uses fixed distance rather than interpolation fraction and does not overshoot; slerp also blends lengths and falls back to lerp for zero vectors. Multiply desired per-second motion by elapsed time and verify at different frame rates.

vector * transform applies orthonormal inverse, whereas transform * vector applies forward transformation; scaled/skewed inverse requires affine_inverse. Round halfway away from zero and use floor for negative grid addressing.

Vector components normally use 32-bit precision despite scalar float being 64-bit. Reject nonfinite inputs, compare distances squared for threshold decisions, and use approximate component comparisons; relational operators sort lexicographically rather than by length.

Use separate unbranched root-to-descendant chains for hair/tail secondary motion; a one-bone chain requires extended tail and tail-disabled last joint configuration has no simulation effect. Avoid scaled skeleton/bone/modifier hierarchy.

Spring collisions are child SpringBoneCollision3D shapes independent of PhysicsServer3D; choose all-children plus exclusion list or explicit inclusion list and validate each chain setting index separately from bone/joint indices.

Center choice controls relative movement: skeleton center removes whole-character world translation from simulated motion. Reset after abrupt pose or teleport changes after upstream modifiers have applied the intended pose to prevent violent inertia.

Gravity parameter represents constant movement velocity rather than physical acceleration; nonzero gravity and zero stiffness prevent return to original pose. Tune drag/stiffness and sampled curves with animated poses, not rigid-body formulas.

Cached rest axes improve performance slightly but ignore prior animated position changes; mutable axes read current pose each frame. Custom hinge axes use pre-simulation pose space and must not be collinear with forward direction because twist forces are absent.

Per-joint editing requires individual config; chain-level values are curve-scaled and cached per joint. Getter drag prose wrongly calls a scalar a curve, so use signature and runtime sampled values when documenting diagnostics.

GraphEdit interaction emits requests rather than editing domain data; implement validated connect/disconnect/delete/copy/paste commands with undo/redo, stable node names, explicit edge cleanup and save/readback of graph plus layout.

Port compatibility uses enabled-port types configured by GraphNode slots, and additional hover validation should agree with final connection validation. keep_alive false allows invalid visual edges to disappear during redraw, so do not treat view connections as the sole model.
Children may expose required _connection_layer; filter GraphElement types during serialization/selection and never delete internal menu HBox. Hide required controls rather than freeing them.

Group node drag begin/end into one undo action; programmatic scroll offsets do not emit user scroll signal. Drag force-end suppresses connection requests except ended, so cancellation lifecycle needs explicit cleanup.

Hit testing mixes graph positions and screen coordinates; test zoom/pan transforms and empty edge misses. Hotzone sample names port_grab_distance_horizontal/vertical contradict the listed inner/outer theme extents and require pinned binding verification.

Layout/minimap/selection/focus themes are functional UX; enable low-processor usage for appropriate editor tools while preserving host configuration on plugin exit, and benchmark large graphs before accepting that recommendation globally.

CPU particles offer a fallback for older hardware but cost CPU simulation; benchmark fixed amount, lifetime, seed and sampling conditions rather than claim GPU/CPU parity or automatic speed improvement. GPU conversion requires ParticleProcessMaterial and cannot translate arbitrary custom process shaders.

Angle/spread use degrees, angular speed degrees per second, orbit velocity rotations per second, and animation speed complete atlas cycles per lifetime. Configure CanvasItemMaterial particle-animation frames/loop explicitly and test lifecycle samples.

Emission points/normals/colors getters return copies; reassign edits and validate directed-point array correspondence. Color/initial gradient/lifetime gradient multiply tint, and split-scale X/Y curves require split_scale.

Local coordinates follow emitter transforms while global particles stay behind; test moving emitters. One-shot finished controls reuse while continuous effects never emit it; pause plus requested emitting/residual time and kept seed supports repeatable timeline seeking.

CPU 2D rotate-Y/disable-Z flags are unused compatibility enum values. Default texture-less output is squares; distinguish missing atlas/material configuration from emission failure using both visual capture and actual timing/state assertions.

Animation is data that needs an AnimationLibrary/mixer for playback; track paths resolve from mixer root_node and colon-delimited properties/bones. Dedicated 3D position/rotation/scale tracks improve performance over generic value tracks.

Length is independent of last key and keys beyond boundaries may support looping/interpolation. Test endpoints, wrap interpolation, reverse/ping-pong playback and nearest/approx/exact key retrieval with explicit -1 checks.

Compression is in-place and lossy with noneditable compressed-track limitations; optimize also modifies keys in-place. Preserve authoring data and compare sampled poses/key events plus saved readback before accepting memory/key-count reductions.

Choose continuous/discrete/capture update mode deliberately and angle interpolation normalizes shortest-path values, so matching raw angle key values is not the correct semantic assertion. Verify actual node properties after playback application.

Audio key start/end offsets trim seconds and blend setting changes volume by animation blend weight; use audible/device checks for timing and crossfade rather than merely asserting an AudioStream reference exists. Markers are sorted by time and navigation can return empty StringName.
Track edits change indices, so refind by path/type after removals/reorders; save and reload external resource to verify track type, path, keys, transitions and loop mode before task completion.

Prefer MenuBar.prefer_global_menu or PopupMenu.prefer_native_menu for ordinary menus; low-level menus require create_menu/free_menu RID ownership and feature queries, with macOS system-menu support distinct from Windows popup support.

Callbacks accept exactly one Variant tag argument; returned insertion/reordering indices can differ from requested indices and separators occupy indices, so retain stable tags and resolve indices after removal or reorder. Radio grouping and check state require application logic.

Windows ignores accelerators and key callbacks; hidden items, hover callbacks, tooltip, indentation and minimum width are macOS-only. Native popup coordinates are screen coordinates; provide ordinary Control fallback when required features are absent.

The pinned descriptions for set_popup_close_callback and set_popup_open_callback appear swapped relative to their method names. Verify bindings and actual callback ordering before implementing; simulated OS opening need not produce a paired close notification, so do not infer lifetime from paired callbacks alone.

Input polling exposes global state even when a Control accepts an event or a Viewport marks it handled. Use event-based unhandled input for gameplay blocked by UI; event-specific just-pressed methods avoid processing unrelated events repeatedly within one tick.

get_vector supplies a length-limited vector and circular deadzone averaged from its four actions unless explicitly overridden. action_press only changes polling state; parse_input_event dispatches _input but does not simulate OS shortcuts or move the OS cursor, so tests must choose the intended layer and release injected actions.

Physical key positions suit movement across keyboard layouts; logical keycodes suit desktop shortcuts and key labels suit printed characters. Accumulated input merges events to rendering FPS; disable temporarily for drawing precision and measure CPU cost, while mouse velocity itself is sampled only every 0.1 second.

Joypad IDs/order are not persistent across restarts; inspect hotplug connections and capability queries rather than assuming ID zero. Sensor calibration is experimental, requires enabling sensors and stationary sampling, and must stop/disable on teardown or disconnection. Calibration snippet is illustrative, not a guarantee that one-second sampling succeeds.

Rumble duration/strength getters retain original arguments after effects expire; use is_joy_vibrating or remaining duration to assess current activity. Handheld vibration needs Android VIBRATE permission and is browser/device-setting dependent; desktop sensor injection does not establish mobile hardware acceptance.

Custom cursor images have bounded sizes/hotspots, no AnimatedTexture animation, and stricter Web limits; VRAM compression is decompressed on CPU without saving cursor memory. warp_mouse is desktop-only, and Control cursor defaults override the viewport-level default.

Godot 4 window, clipboard and TTS operations belong to DisplayServer/Window and time operations to Time. Global cache/config/data directories differ from project-specific user://; Web persistence requires an explicit is_userfs_persistent check and save/reload acceptance.

OS.execute blocks and returns exit status, while create_process/execute_with_pipe create independent children that outlive Godot. Pipe mode controls blocking I/O rather than process lifetime; nonblocking reads need get_error checks, simultaneous stderr draining and explicit child cleanup. PID status/exit queries apply only to spawned children and may return -1 ambiguously.

Custom CLI arguments should follow -- and use get_cmdline_user_args. The illustrative split-every-equals parser loses values containing equals, so implement bounded splitting and schema validation; preserve engine and user separators explicitly when restarting.

delay and alert block the calling/main thread, including editor tools. Driver-info first lookup can take seconds: use one worker and join it, avoid concurrent calls because it is not thread-safe. Static memory usage/peak work only in debug builds and system memory fields may be -1; separate allocator metrics from process/GPU memory.

Permission requests return true only for already-granted permission and require asynchronous result handling plus export declarations. macOS sandbox helper/file access, mobile dangerous permissions, Web MIDI permission and missing capabilities require platform-specific acceptance rather than desktop extrapolation.

Device unique IDs can change and be forged; do not derive persistent encryption keys or authorization from them. Recycle-bin operations may permanently delete when trash is disabled; use global paths and check Error. Save-and-swap replaces a target on close but still needs failure, corruption and readback tests for a save format.

Restart-on-exit is standalone desktop-only and does not recover crashes or forced kills. Console stdin can permanently block Windows GUI exports without the console wrapper; inspect handle type and use worker/nonblocking design. System font candidates are not guaranteed to render requested text and need glyph/fallback checks.

CodeEdit supplies editing affordances rather than language semantics: explicitly enable completion, gutters, folding and indentation, then provide a parser/completion backend and debugger integration. Its default left-to-right source direction is intentional even in RTL locales.

Completion requires adding candidate options and submitting update_code_completion_options, replacing the previous candidate set; overriding _request_code_completion suppresses the request signal. Distinguish display_text from insert_text and test merge versus replace confirmation, forced queries and stale asynchronous responses.

Context extraction inserts U+FFFF at caret/cursor location; feed this sentinel to the parser without persisting it into saved source. is_in_string/is_in_comment return delimiter indices or -1, not booleans; delimiter-position queries can return (-1,-1) and require explicit failure handling.

Comment/string opening delimiters must be unique symbols; line-only or empty closing delimiters end at the current line. Code regions need a single-line comment delimiter, while folding also uses indentation and string/comment blocks; enabling the gutter alone does not activate folding.

Breakpoint/bookmark/execution markers are Control state; connect breakpoint_toggled to the actual debugger and reconcile line edits/deletions. Multicaret editing methods affect all selected/caret lines, so verify text, carets, markers and undo rather than only the first selection.

Symbol lookup needs symbol_validate responses via set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid, and hover tooltips additionally need symbol_tooltip_on_hover plus configured delay. Validate navigation target existence and reload saved source separately from UI marker rendering.

visionOS uses the AppleEmbedded exporter and separate debug/release signing identity, provisioning specifier/UUID and distribution choices. Profile environment overrides use GODOT_APPLE_PLATFORM_* names; inspect the resulting Xcode project and archive before claiming a signed device export.

The pinned exporter page still describes iOS project files, iPhone A12/A17 device restrictions and iTunes sharing, and min_visionos_version lacks prose. These inherited descriptions do not establish visionOS device support or deployment target semantics; verify platform bindings and SDK output, and retain Apple host/device execution as untested here.

delete_old_export_files_unconditionally deletes project-name and project-name.xcodeproj entries at the destination. Use a dedicated verified export directory and preserve modifications to previously generated projects rather than silently enabling this option.

Info.plist and entitlement additions are XML key/value fragments inside the root dict; validate generated plist structure, bundle identifier characters, Team ID and distinct user-visible/build versions. Project-only export is a handoff to a separate archive pipeline and is not evidence that compilation/signing succeeds.

Privacy manifests distinguish collection, purposes, identity linkage and tracking separately across ordinary and spatial categories including hands/head/environment scans. Match declarations to actual game and plugin behavior; usage-description localization and camera module inclusion do not themselves grant runtime permission.

Shader baking applies only to Forward+/Mobile and is disabled for dedicated servers. Packed capability/tracking-domain getters return copies requiring reassignment. Document/Files sharing exposes app data intentionally and requires save-format robustness against external edits.

Server changes synchronize after physics frames and may use background iterations; iteration zero means never synchronized and IDs wrap to one. Wait for a synchronized map/region and actual cross-region query results rather than using deprecated map_force_update, which flushes the global queue and is incompatible with async updates.

Region edges connect by paired vertex proximity, not arbitrary overlap. Match map cell size/height to baked meshes, enable map and region edge connections, inspect connection count/pathway endpoints, and assert reachability across the seam; link connection radius is a separate polygon search threshold.

Avoidance ignores navigable regions and does not physically move bodies. Apply safe velocity through the physics controller and reconcile actual position each tick. Low-level callbacks run independently of SceneTree pause/lifetime until disabled, paused or freed; explicitly tear them down and free owned RIDs.

Ground XZ avoidance and full XYZ avoidance only interact with their own mode. Full 3D ignores vertex obstacles; ground mode uses height separation and outline winding determines push-in/push-out. Avoidance masks/priorities are separate from path navigation layers.

Wanted velocity differs from internal forced velocity: reset forced velocity in the teleport frame but frequent forcing can stick agents. Tune neighbors, distance and time horizons with dense encounter measurements; excessive horizons slow movement while too few neighbors weaken safety.

Parse source SceneTree geometry on the main thread/deferred call, then bake source-data resources asynchronously and handle completion before installation. Mesh array readback can stall RenderingServer; prefer collision/code-generated arrays. Custom parser callbacks add geometry to source data rather than editing NavigationMesh itself.

region_owns_point means nearest-region ownership and ties depend on registration order, not geometric containment; avoid overlapping regions. Uniform random queries weight surface area at extra cost, and path simplification epsilon uses world units, so retest collision clearance and endpoint reachability after simplification.

macOS architecture options are x86_64, arm64 and universal, with official templates universal; separate minimum OS versions per architecture and inspect every embedded native dependency slice. Metadata SDK/Xcode fields describe the built executable and do not install a toolchain.

App Sandbox requires explicit outgoing versus incoming networking, Bluetooth for wireless controllers, USB for wired controllers and native file-dialog selected access. Helpers must be embedded in the bundle; validate exported sandbox behavior rather than assuming editor execution paths work.

A custom entitlements plist causes the other configured entitlement options to be ignored, so inspect the final signature entitlements rather than checking preset toggles alone. Microphone/camera/contact/calendar/photo/location access additionally requires usage descriptions and runtime consent.

Native add-ons and ad-hoc signing can require disabling library validation; JIT, unsigned executable memory and dyld injection allowances should be tied to the actual language/add-on requirement. Debugging entitlement is temporary and should be disabled in production; verify signed extension loading on the target Mac.

App signing and installer identity are separate, with provisioning, notarization tool and API/App-specific password options. Prefer supplied environment overrides for secret values and record nonsecret certificate identity/results; an exported ZIP or successful signing alone does not establish Gatekeeper/notarization acceptance.

Liquid Glass icons require macOS export with Xcode 26+ and only appear on macOS 26, so preserve ordinary icon fallback. HiDPI changes actual rendered resolution and needs visual/performance acceptance; shader baker is Forward+/Mobile only and absent for dedicated servers.

Privacy collection/purpose/linkage/tracking declarations need actual game/plugin inventory. SSH deploy run/cleanup scripts substitute temporary directory/archive/executable/arguments and require properly quoted, scoped cleanup; this documentation reading grants no remote deployment execution evidence.

Low-level spaces/bodies/areas/shapes/joints are independent of scene nodes and need explicit space assignment, activation, state synchronization and owned-RID cleanup. Shape removal/clearing does not free reusable shape RIDs; never free borrowed server RIDs or assume attaching an ObjectID creates/manages a scene node.

Created server areas default to layer/mask one and monitorable false, while created bodies default rigid. Monitor callbacks report individual shape pairs with status/RID/ObjectID/other/self indices; maintain pair counts to derive whole-object first-enter/last-exit and validate removed objects before resolving IDs.

Force applies every physics update, impulse applies once, and constant-force additions persist until cleared rather than being re-added each tick. Positioned force/impulse arguments are global-axis offsets from body origin, not absolute world positions; reset accumulated force and torque independently.

Custom integration callbacks precede standard force integration and change arity when userdata is nonnull. Omit integration disables automatic force/torque/damping updates, while state-sync callbacks only run if the body was active in the previous tick; sleeping bodies and missing direct state require explicit diagnosis.

Jolt ignores many legacy bias/damping/restitution/softness joint parameters and joint solver priority, so readback success cannot prove changed behavior. Record the actual physics backend and test limit/motor/constraint behavior; GodotPhysics shape margins are unused, while custom shapes are unsupported by both built-in backends.

Shape payload formats differ from high-level resource properties: box data uses half-extents, concave data uses faces triples plus backface_collision, capsule/cylinder use height/radius dictionaries, and heightmaps require width*depth packed floats matching engine precision. Validate shapes/data before testing collision and retest geometry edits.

Area gravity/damping overrides depend on priority and combine/replace modes; point gravity follows inverse-square only with positive unit distance. Area wind applies only to soft bodies. Pinned soft-body drag/state support is implementation-dependent, pinning makes points kinematic but movable, and higher precision/solver iterations require measured CPU tradeoffs.

body_test_motion reports whether a hypothetical motion would collide and supplies a result; it does not move the body. Several pinned method descriptions contain copied area text or misplaced CCD prose, so verify binding and behavior rather than copying those statements into implementation recipes.

Global functions and enums require language-specific bindings: prefer typed scalar/vector operations, Mathf/GD and exact C# enum casts rather than mechanically copying GDScript globals. The pinned C# instance_from_id sample has undefined Id and an unqualified call, and lerp_angle still extends obsolete Sprite; correct these before creating runnable recipes.

Property hints configure Inspector presentation rather than runtime validation. FILE uses UID when available whereas FILE_PATH stores a raw path that breaks on moves; flag enum explicit values do not renumber later entries. Nested array/dictionary hint strings require type/hint encoding and trailing colons; test real Inspector editing plus save/readback.

Usage STORAGE and EDITOR are independent; editor-only Callable tool buttons should not be serialized, READ_ONLY restricts Inspector editing only, and SECRET separates confidential export values. Dynamic property arrays need _get_property_list plus swap handling; duplicate flags and RESOURCE_NOT_PERSISTENT affect resource serialization/ownership and require reload tests.

Generic clamp/min/max on vectors use comparison ordering, not component-wise bounds; use vector methods. Floor differs from int truncation on negatives, round ties go away from zero, wrap upper bound is exclusive, remap zero input range is undefined, and approximate equality can consider infinities equal; validate finite values before simulation/save/network acceptance.

Interpolation weights extrapolate unless bounded; bound the weight to zero/one rather than copying the lerpf prose that suggests clamping the result without endpoint bounds. Angle interpolation at opposite directions is ambiguous under floating-point precision; choose direction explicitly when behavior matters.

Object-decoding variants can execute code and must not deserialize untrusted saves/network payloads. Callable serialization yields empty data, signal/string conversion is unsupported, type_convert silently returns type defaults on failure, and ObjectIDs/RIDs are process-lifetime handles rather than persisted domain identity; schema validation must precede conversion.

Global RNG automatically randomizes at startup; explicit seed supports repeatability but unrelated global calls disturb sequence, so isolated task RNG state is preferable. randi_range is signed 32-bit and endpoints are inclusive; modulus sampling and fixed-seed cross-version determinism require separate decisions and evidence.

push_error does not stop execution or provide a failing process exit; validation must collect failure state and explicitly quit with nonzero code. Many APIs print errors without returning Error, so capture logs and assert actual behavior. NativeMenu singleton macOS-only prose conflicts with its own Windows support notes; verify capability/backend rather than using this index note as exclusion.

CMD_OR_CTRL is mapping-only and absent from actual events; joy button names denote physical positions across controller brands. MIDI note-on velocity zero can mean note-off, and several system-message data payloads are unimplemented; provide device/capability checks and real event acceptance.

Headless display disables window rendering and commonly returns dummy values; native-window, screenshot, HDR and platform UX acceptance requires the applicable real display backend. Query has_feature and runtime support rather than infer availability from OS alone.

HDR requested, supported and currently enabled are separate states; enabled/support can change with display moves and OS settings. In pinned 4.7.2, requesting HDR on each Window directly enables its internal RenderingServer viewport HDR 2D buffer when the explicit Viewport setting is false; this does not update the stored use_hdr_2d getter. Other SubViewports require explicit HDR 2D settings. React to output_max_linear_value_changed; SDR returns 1.0, but 1.0 alone does not establish SDR.

Negative HDR maximum/reference luminance selects OS automatic values; configured values differ from current resolved values and their ratio is meaningful even when physical nits are inaccurate. Maximum override is documented only for macOS/Windows, reference override only Windows; keep platform-specific calibration and real-screen evidence.

Prefer Window properties/signals; replacing low-level drop/input/text/rect/window-event callbacks overrides Window implementations and can introduce bugs. Transient windows cannot enter fullscreen; popup flags cannot change while visible and require transient parents. Fullscreen forces borderless true, requiring restoration.

Android native file picker returns SAF content URI, and directory access uses treeUri#relative/path with FileAccess. Persistable URI permission requires AndroidRuntime and can expire after rename/move/delete. The GDScript example incorrectly uses val declarations and must not be copied unchanged. Dialog callbacks and extra-options callbacks have different arities.

Accessibility element updates and enums are deprecated in favor of AccessibilityServer; Nodes own their elements automatically. Accessibility preference queries return -1 for unknown, and inspector tools do not count as assistive apps: enable accessibility support explicitly when testing.

Display coordinates may be negative/outside monitors; client and decorated geometry differ. Wayland position setter is a no-op and fractional scale is accurate only with SCREEN_OF_MAIN_WINDOW. Safe-area cutout query is Android-only; empty elsewhere does not prove no notch.

Screen capture is unavailable on Wayland and XWayland; macOS permissions may silently exclude other apps. Exclude-from-capture flag is not a security guarantee. Native image clipboard expects pixel data rather than copied filesystem files.

TTS depends on installed system libraries/voices; empty voice lists require graceful fallback. Boundary callback takes character index plus utterance ID whereas started/ended/canceled takes ID only; queue interruption, stop and canceled outcomes need tests. SSML and pitch/rate granularity vary by engine and voice.

Global menu APIs are deprecated; migrate NativeMenu or PopupMenu with explicit tag callbacks and manual radio state. Status-indicator menus suppress macOS activation callbacks but Windows preserves other-button callbacks; explicitly delete indicators and own menu lifecycle.

VSync enumeration claims Engine.max_fps is ignored and setter claims all modes except enabled require Forward+/Mobile, including disabled; verify engine binding/implementation and runtime before relying on these potentially conflicting statements. Cursor WAIT/BUSY prose conflicts with Input reference; orientation_changed values are not interchangeable with ScreenOrientation enum.

Bypassing scene Nodes addresses scene-system CPU bottlenecks only, not an already saturated GPU. Own every created RID and free it explicitly; 3D resources need instances attached to a scenario and viewport, whereas 2D items need a canvas ancestry attached to a viewport. Headless returns dummy data and cannot establish rendering correctness.

Record actual rendering method, driver and adapter after CLI overrides and hardware fallback. Global or local RenderingDevice is null with OpenGL/headless; a local device cannot draw to screen or share data with the global device. Use call_on_render_thread for global rendering internals; force_draw requires main thread and force_sync has CPU/GPU synchronization cost.

Enable viewport timing explicitly or readouts are zero. CPU render time excludes scripts and other subsystems; sum drawn viewport CPU times plus frame setup time, and sum viewport GPU times separately. Render statistics require at least two drawn frames; some global counters omit2D so compare visible, shadow and canvas passes separately. Fixed FPS caps can reduce GPU clock and distort timings.

Global shader get/get_list/get_type and viewport_get_update_mode can synchronize threads; keep script-side state rather than query during gameplay. MultiMesh GPU buffer retrieval can read back/decompress data. Pipeline compilation counters distinguish loading, surface cache, draw-time stutter and background specialization; video memory includes uncategorized allocations in RD renderers.

Bulk MultiMesh buffer size must equal allocated instances times stride:2D8transform floats or3D12, plus4color and/or4custom floats. Transform rows differ from Godot basis column storage;2D includes padding. Invalid size prints error and renders nothing. Indirect command buffer only exists after use_indirect allocation and indexed/nonindexed layouts differ.

Mesh positions are consecutive while normals/tangents interleave separately; query format-specific offsets and strides including index16/32bit rather than assume12bytes. Compressed attributes require vertices with both normals and tangents, or vertices alone; mesh format version matters. Surface removal shifts indices; shadow mesh must preserve exact positions including LODs.

Texture update requires existing dimensions/format (and depth/all layers for3D); mismatch prints error without modification. texture_replace preserves destination RID. texture_set_path is a hint, not saving; size override changes display only. texture_rd_create owns wrapper separately: RenderingServer.free_rid does not free underlying RD texture. Native handles require driver-specific interpretation and encoding.

HDR2D renders linear floating buffers and is separate from requesting HDR display output. Filmic/ACES tonemappers and Softlight glow output only SDR; prefer suitable alternatives and verify real display. Several debug views replace custom shaders, hiding vertex displacement; Compatibility wireframes require enabling generation before mesh loading.

Canvas commands persist until clear; background animation slices can avoid repeated redraw. Repeated complex polygons benefit from cached triangulation. Rect clipping ignores rotation; custom visibility rect reduces bound calculation only if it encloses actual drawings.2D SDF affects Canvas shaders and GPUParticles2D, not3D SDFGI; enum prose incorrectly refers to GPUParticles3D.

All particles_* methods control GPU particles, not CPU particles; CPUParticles use MultiMesh internally. Stopping emission does not reset living particles; restart applies next update. Process material differs from draw material. Particle timeline seeking combines speed scale0 with explicit emission/residual simulation time.

Geometry transparency greater than0 forces slower transparent pipeline and sorting issues yet retains shadows. Ignore-all-culling includes layer/frustum, unlike ignore-occlusion-only. Use instance_teleport after relocation to reset motion vectors; visual cull queries force pending updates and are primarily editor queries, so gameplay interactions should use physics.

Direct-to-screen viewport rendering sacrifices screen texture/readback and stretch behavior; root viewport draws last and can overwrite it. Dynamic sky TIME/POSITION selects realtime processing constrained to256cubemap; slowly changing uniforms favor incremental radiance. Global shadow/GI/filter settings cannot be isolated per viewport despite method prefix.

Deprecated has_feature always returns false, texture_proxy_create returns invalid RID, reflection_probe_set_resolution and SSR roughness setter do nothing; enum descriptions still advertise roughness quality behavior. light_directional_set_sky_mode prose says boolean although signature is enum. Mesh attribute/skin update prose copies vertex position byte layouts; mesh_add_surface material field says Material while related server APIs use RID. Verify source bindings and runtime before copying these contradictions.

RD requires actual Forward+/Mobile graphics device; unavailable headless/Compatibility. Use initialized global or created local device, not unexplained RenderingDevice.new snippets. submit/sync are local-only and sync requires prior submit; local has one queued frame and no screen framebuffer/size/draw capability.

Draw/compute lists are exclusive within their type and must end before buffer update/copy/clear or texture updates. DrawFlags selects clear or discard per attachment, never both; discard leaves garbage unless overwritten. InitialAction/FinalAction and barrier/full_barrier/split lists are deprecated/no-op; explicit compute_list_add_barrier remains documented for dependent compute dispatches.

Match shader set/binding layouts, vertex/framebuffer format and binary push-constant layout; dispatch counts are workgroups, not total invocations. Query limits for workgroup axes, total invocations, shared memory and push constants;128byte push constant budget improves portability. Device-address feature and creation flag must both be enabled.

Buffer/texture synchronous readback blocks GPU; asynchronous callbacks return request-time data after queued frames and still consume bandwidth/memory. Texture readback needs CAN_COPY_FROM, update needs CAN_UPDATE, copies need source/destination flags and matching color/depth types. Resolve requires multisampled source and nonmultisampled destination with identical dimensions/format/type.

Explicit RID ownership includes dependency invalidation: shader destruction frees pipelines and uniform sets, any uniform resource destruction frees set, source textures free shared views/framebuffers, and buffers free arrays. Track valid handles and free order to avoid double-free/use-after-free. Format IDs are cached integers and do not need freeing.

Raw texture initialization uses one byte array for1D/2D/3D and one per layer for arrays/cubemaps. Shared slice prose first mentions3D/cubemap but subsequently limits layer slicing to2Darrays; verify supported slice type. Native image import/driver-resource handles require matching driver objects, usage and external ownership; do not assumeVulkan acrossMetal/D3D12.

GPU tracking memory counters may return0 when unknown/nottracked; detailed CSV requiresVulkandebug and --extra-gpu-memory-tracking. Timestamp values are microseconds since startup and delayed frame index is available; subtract within the same clock and frame. Shader binary/cache UUID depends onGPU+driver; portableSPIRV differs from native bytecode.

Raytracing APIs are experimental and documented Vulkan-only with feature checks. BLAS must build beforeTLAS; rebuilding/freeing BLAS invalidatesTLAS. SBT ranges must cover geometry*traceStride+offset, initialize fully and notremainreferencedwhenfreed. Pipeline replacement preserves existing hit-group order and adds only at end.

Reference snippets are materially stale: device-address example uses nonexistent STORAGE_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS; acceleration-input creation bits are passed in third usage slot rather than fourth creation_bits. draw_list_begin examples use invalid GDScript1.0f, missing CLEAR_COLOR_ALL constant and obsolete argument count. Must verify binding and compile before reuse.

DataFormat prose contains incorrect signed ranges (positive lower32/64bit bounds),A1R5G5B5 green6bits and12X4 padding6bits, planar count mismatches, packed ABGR channel-order wording; use format names/version-matched source for binary packing rather than copy prose. RD has_feature is active unlike RenderingServer obsolete method; unsupported formats/filter/sample counts require capability queries.

Resource names require verbose/dev build and debug-utils support, framebuffer naming is unsupported; command labels must balance and insertion is no-op due reorder. Breadcrumb provides GPU crash context in dev/debug builds, not runtime rendering behavior. Geometry adjacency is exposed but geometry shaders are not supported, so avoid claiming corresponding authoring capability.

Custom TextServer backends require the full required virtual contract for RID ownership, font metrics/cache drawing, shaping, span mutation and glyph retrieval; inheriting the class alone does not provide a production text engine. Cleanup precedes unregistering and _has must recognize resources owned by this backend.

Raw font-data, CaretInfo and const Glyph pointer signatures require native binding and lifetime verification; do not invent GDScript pointer recipes. Glyph indices, Unicode characters, logical order and visual order are separate concepts. Runs are returned in visual order, while spans retain source metadata and inline objects use unique keys and replacement-character lengths.

Font cache keys include size and outline size. Advancement, baseline offsets, UV rectangles and texture indices need separate assertions; spacing uses pixels, weight is 100..999 and stretch is 50..200 percent. Bitmap fixed-size and MSDF caches behave differently; MSDF avoids rerasterizing across sizes but disables hinting and can reduce small-text readability.

Positive font oversampling overrides viewport oversampling but does not override positive draw-method oversampling. Viewports manage oversampling reference counts and zero-count cache freeing; backend consumers should not directly call these reference callbacks.

Shaping success/readiness must be checked before measuring or reading glyphs; substring ranges refer to a parent buffer. Grapheme hit-testing can return -1 whereas caret-position hit-testing always returns a valid position. Composite-character boundaries, word ranges and BiDi caret/selection geometry need RTL, combining-mark and inline-object validation.

Support data can provide ICU breaking dictionaries and is optional with locale-specific need detection. Language and script overrides use different identifiers; custom punctuation empty restores defaults. Numeric formatting/parsing and percent-sign callbacks are deprecated in favor of TranslationServer.

Color glyph modulation is independently controlled; palette overrides use empty array to reset and transparent black to preserve a predefined entry. OpenType feature overrides and variation coordinates are separate font settings. Confusable/spoof checks are heuristics rather than authorization validation; undocumented _is_valid_letter requires source verification.

Use TextEdit for multiline input and CodeEdit for advanced code editing. Autowrap takes effect only with boundary wrapping; fitting minimum size to content still scrolls when a maximum size is exceeded. Horizontal scroll is pixels but vertical scroll is line numbers, and wrapped/folded visible counts differ from source line count.

Multicaret index -1 means all, 0 main and positive indices secondary. Pair begin/end_complex_operation for one undo step and begin/end_multicaret_edit to defer merges; skip multicaret_edit_ignore_caret entries. Removing carets changes other indices and moving/selecting does not automatically merge overlaps. Deprecated adjust_carets_after_edit does nothing and edit-order sorting is no longer necessary.

IME display text and committed text differ: get_line_with_ime includes composition; apply_ime commits to each caret, cancel_ime discards composition. Language controls shaping/breaking; test RTL, combining marks and emoji. Pinned 4.7.2 text_edit.cpp resolves the backspace prose conflict: mid-grapheme enabled OR composite-character deletion disabled removes one codepoint; otherwise deletion uses the previous composite-character boundary. The unconditional note is stale; actual emoji and combining-character behavior remains untested.

clear performs a full reset including undo history. Saved-version tagging records undo-history version, not a filesystem write; persist the document successfully before tagging and test dirty state across edits, undo and reload. text_set is emitted for clear/text assignment while lines_edited_from is immediate and reverses range ordering for removals.

Search and hit-test vector x is column and y is line, not line-first; failed search or unclamped out-of-range hit tests return (-1,-1). Pixel position uses line bottom while grapheme rect uses top. is_caret_visible is not a global on-screen check and can be stale until next drawing frame.

SyntaxHighlighter instances must not be shared between TextEdits. Internal PopupMenu must not be freed, IDs must avoid standard menu enums and is_menu_visible avoids creating it. C# menu sample uses enum arithmetic and event handler signatures that require actual binding/compiler verification before reuse.

Readonly, selection, shortcuts and tab focus are independent: disabling selection blocks programmatic select too; context-menu disabling does not disable shortcuts, and tab_input_mode switches between text insertion and focus navigation. Primary clipboard/middle paste is Linux-specific; virtual keyboard requires platform support.

Custom gutter callbacks receive line, gutter and Rect2 and need custom gutter type; global clickability supersedes per-line settings and only overwritable gutters merge. Preserve focus indication for keyboard accessibility, MSDF pixel range must be at least twice outline size and selected-font transparent color means inherit rather than hide.

Agent computes global path points but does not move its parent or guarantee physical collision clearance. Call get_next_path_position once per active physics frame, stop updates after finished to avoid jitter and avoid recalculating methods inside immediate waypoint callbacks to prevent recursion.

Finished does not imply target reached: unreachable targets finish at reachable final waypoint; target reachability uses target_desired_distance. Oversmall distances cause overshoot repath loops, oversized path distance skips corners. Search limits can return a partial path and path-length zero can mean not yet calculated.

Avoidance and navigation masks are separate. Agent radius/height affect avoidance rather than navmesh baking; distinct actor sizes need appropriately baked meshes/maps. 2D XZ and omnidirectional 3D avoidance populations do not interact; 3D ignores vertex obstacles, height only affects 2D and keep_y_velocity preserves vertical movement.

Use velocity_computed safe velocity to move the actual physics body, keeping desired and actual motion separate. Avoidance registration costs scale with agents/neighbors/horizons. Reset internal velocity with set_velocity_forced in teleport frame, not continuously.

Change node map through set_navigation_map rather than direct server agent mutation, so node and server state agree. Path metadata controls link/waypoint keys and links still require traversal logic. time_horizon_obstacles default 0 conflicts with must-positive prose; verify accepted zero semantics before prescribing values.

Begin geometry then set each vertex attribute before add_vertex; first vertex fixes attribute format and omitted later values reuse the last values. Godot front faces use clockwise winding. Commit(existing) appends a surface rather than replacing existing geometry, so assert surface count and saved arrays.

Generate normals after triangles before commit, selecting smooth groups >=0 or flat group -1; generate tangents also needs UVs and normals. Vertex colors require material vertex_color_use_as_albedo; tangent Plane xyz is tangent and d handedness, not geometric plane.

Index deduplicates vertex data and deindex expands it; optimize_indices_for_cache needs triangles. generate_lod is deprecated because normals/UVs are not preserved; route to ImporterMesh.generate_lods and measure rendered quality.

Custom channel formats must be configured after begin and before custom values/commit, unused channels report CUSTOM_MAX. Non-RGBA formats discard channels. Skin weight count is an enum (0 or1), not literal4/8; documentation four-value bone/weight notes need reconciliation with enabled eight-weight mode. C# uint32.MaxValue spelling is invalid: use uint.MaxValue or UInt32.MaxValue after binding verification.

Distinguish parent-space position/rotation from object-local translate_object_local and global operations. translate is an historical object-local exception despite naming. top_level detaches transform inheritance but not lifetime; get_parent_node_3d differs from get_parent and global getters outside tree return failure defaults.

Angles are radians except explicit degree properties; Inspector degree presentation does not change stored rotation units. Local Euler rotation follows rotation_order while global rotation always YXZ. look_at uses -Z camera front or +Z model front, requires nonzero up and nonparallel/noncoincident target; nonuniform scaling can fail.

Mixed-sign or zero scale cannot reliably decompose/persist and can be lost after reload. orthonormalize removes local scale while set_disable_scale orthonormalizes global transform without modifying local transform. Assert saved/reloaded transform, not only Inspector values.

Visibility walks consecutive Node3D ancestors and a generic Node breaks inheritance; is_visible_in_tree ignores render layers/culling and does not prove pixels visible. Visibility-parent range dependencies require GeometryInstance3D and are distinct from ordinary visibility/lifecycle.

Transform notifications differ local versus global and are opt-in except specialized nodes; suppress notifications around handlers to prevent recursion. force_update_transform needs tree membership and should be reserved for immediate needs. Interpolated frame transform differs from latest physics state and first query creates interpolation pump; initialize before reset to avoid streaking. Gizmos/subgizmo APIs are editor-only.

Native OpenXR extension bridge exposes instance/session/space/action handles and function pointers cast to integer; zero function pointer means unavailable. const void pose/space and projection pointers need native API types/lifetimes and cannot become invented GDScript pointer recipes. This low-level bridge is a native XR boundary, not a tested backend implementation.

Enabled, initialized, running and can_render are distinct conditions. OpenXR version is valid after instance creation; view count need not be two and next versus current predicted display timing differs. Projection layer and near/far render-state access are rendering-thread-only.

Register frame/projection/composition providers before session starts (on_session_created allowed), pair unregister after session stops and balance nested debug labels. Runtime error helper verifies XrResult and logs contextual errors; debug object names require valid typed handles.

Custom swapchains require queried supported formats and acquire/use/release/free lifecycle; wrapper pointer differs from XrSwapchain handle and borrowed image RID ownership needs native source verification before frees. Alpha support distinguishes real, emulated and unsupported; emulation is separate setup. Velocity textures/regions/recommended-size updates need actual renderer/runtime/headset validation, currently untested.

Single/multi/toggle selections have different signals, activation uses double-click or Enter and programmatic select does not emit selection signals. Disabled items cannot select or activate; right-click selection and allow_reselect need explicit configuration. Keep metadata IDs separate from mutable indices after sort/move/remove.

Item strings do not accept newline layout; wrapping requires top icon mode and positive fixed_column_width, and max_text_lines reserves lines even for short text. Unlimited columns=0 means one row while wraparound and horizontal scrolling choose overflow behavior; icons require both fixed dimensions positive.

Hit tests default to closest item rather than exact (-1 on empty), and hit/rect values can be stale until redraw after mutation. force_update_list_size can advance layout but real focus/keyboard/geometry needs actual visual checks. Click positions are local and need screen conversion for popups.

Do not free borrowed internal scrollbars. Item language/translation/direction controls are separate from text and tooltip data. Theme covers focused/unfocused cursor, hover and selected states; preserve focus feedback and use MSDF pixel range at least twice text outline size. Negative indices are promised for set methods, not universally for all item operations.

Each direct Control child becomes a content tab, noncontrols ignored; active tab controls visibility but hidden contents can still process according to Node mode. Use child references/metadata rather than stable assumptions about indices after drag/reparent. current_tab=-1 means no selection and deselect_enabled permits header-only state.

tab_changed differs from tab_clicked and tab_selected: selected emits even for current tab and script selection. Cross-container rearrangement requires same group and drag enabled; -1 disables cross-container moves. Hover-switch while dragging content differs from dragging tabs.

Use TabContainer methods rather than editing/freeing borrowed TabBar; remove Popup association before owned popup teardown and verify lifetime since getter warning assumes internal ownership although setter accepts caller Popup. Clip tabs chooses scroll buttons versus larger minimum width and use_hidden_tabs_for_min_size can stabilize content layout.

Property prose has copied errors: icon describes title, title describes tooltip and tabs_position describes horizontal alignment though enum is top/bottom. tabs_visible text claims content hidden too and requires source/runtime check rather than treating hiding header as hiding content. all_tabs_in_front is deprecated no-op.

Title defaults to child name; empty tooltip falls back to truncated title and space suppresses it. Local hit test returns -1 for no tab. Preserve tab keyboard focus indication and test overflow, RTL, hidden/disabled selection and popup controls visually; MSDF range needs twice outline size.

Color stores four float32 channels and may exceed1 for HDR; sRGB nonlinear RGB is usual default while lighting and luminance need linear RGB. Conversion methods preserve linear alpha; Color alone contains no encoding tag, so document boundary encoding and avoid double conversion.

Scalar/component arithmetic multiplies/divides/adds alpha too; preserve alpha for HDR highlight scaling and guard zero divisors. inverted preserves alpha whereas GDScript unary-minus documentation means WHITE-minus including alpha and needs cross-language binding verification. blend prose reverses overlay direction in its first sentence; example shows bg.blend(fg) paints fg over bg.

GDScript default Color is opaque black and boolean false only for opaque black; transparent Color is truthy. C# default struct is transparent black and constants use Colors.PascalCase; do not port default/color-validity logic mechanically. TRANSPARENT constant is white RGB alpha0, distinct from transparent black and web-prefixed names differ from X11 names.

HTML parsing accepts3/4/6/8 hex digits with optional hash; use html_is_valid or from_string explicit fallback before persistence. Integer RGBA/ARGB/ABGR packing and16-bit packing need order/signed-language roundtrip tests. to_html loses precision and optional alpha; use approximate comparisons after8-bit conversions.

from_rgba8 divides rather than enforcing0..255 and can produce overbright values. Luminance prose claims0..1 despite overbright input; verify range assumptions rather than clamp HDR inadvertently. Constructor C# Color8 example has five arguments and requires correction; GDScript constant-expression integer constructor advice is not listed in constructor table and needs parser/binding check. HSV and OKHSL perceptual choices differ and ordinary component lerp does not automatically operate in linear-light space.
